195.name: ringmaster_spotlight
195.desc: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.
195.lore: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.

196.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
196.desc: Use: Saddle Up Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 10 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

278.name: ringmaster_weighted_pie
278.desc: Use: Toss Pie Knocks enemies back, slows them by 45% and reduces their vision to 50 recovering over 3 seconds, and prevents them from receiving vision from their allies for the duration. Instantly kills any non-ancient creep.

280.name: ringmaster_crystal_ball
280.desc: Use: Clairvoyance Scans a targeted 450 area with global range for 5 seconds. Indicates whether there are enemy heroes in that area for the duration. Reveals invisible units and wards in the scanned area, but does not provide vision. The reveal effect lingers for 1 second.

296.name: tiny_craggy_exterior
296.desc: Enemies that attack Tiny receive a stacking debuff that lowers their attack damage with each stack.

320.name: enchantress_bunny_hop
320.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

321.name: rattletrap_overclocking
321.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
321.lore: Rattletrap understands the limitations of his armor. Just as he understands the risks of pushing past them in times of need.

322.name: pudge_eject
322.desc: Ejects the swallowed allied hero inside of you.

333.name: lycan_wolf_bite
333.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

338.name: treant_natures_grasp
338.desc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.
338.lore: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.

343.name: drow_ranger_multishot
343.desc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
343.lore: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.

352.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
352.desc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to 1 second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
352.lore: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.

383.name: ringmaster_the_box
383.desc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
383.lore: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.

385.name: ringmaster_wheel
385.desc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by -50%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than 0.5 seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after 4 seconds.
385.lore: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.

386.name: ringmaster_impalement
386.desc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
386.lore: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.

387.name: ringmaster_empty_souvenir
387.desc: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

388.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
388.desc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

389.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
389.desc: Use: Proportion Distortion Creates 1 imperfect image of your hero that lasts 18 seconds. Your illusion deals 28% and takes 300% damage.

390.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
390.desc: Use: Whoopsie Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 250 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -30%.

392.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
392.desc: Use: Forcefully Imbibe Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by 5 plus 1 per Ringmaster's level for 8 seconds. The effect holds for 4 seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

398.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_the_box_strong_dispel_and_flying
398.dname: Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying

419.name: juggernaut_swift_slash
419.desc: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.
419.lore: A briefer onslaught for those less deserving of the honor.

425.name: terrorblade_terror_wave
425.desc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
425.lore: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.

464.name: special_bonus_unique_lifestealer_4
464.dname: {s:bonus_attack_speed_on_target} Attack Speed on Open Wounds Target

503.name: special_bonus_unique_night_stalker_5
503.dname: +{s:bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night}% Hunter In The Night Movement Speed

506.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_5
506.dname: +15 Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons

530.name: special_bonus_unique_lich_6
530.dname: +{s:bonus_radius} Frost Blast Radius and Area Damage

539.name: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
539.desc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
539.lore: When it serves his purpose, Leshrac briefly reduces his presence in the Terrene Plane.

541.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_8
541.dname: +{s:bonus_damage_per_kill} Finger of Death Damage Per Kill

547.name: meepo_petrify
547.desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

605.name: kunkka_tidal_wave
605.desc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
605.lore: A good sailor knows the timing of the tides like the back of his hand.

613.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_6
613.dname: +250 Health to Beastmaster and his summons

624.name: special_bonus_unique_keeper_of_the_light_10
624.dname: +{s:bonus_stun_duration}s Solar Bind Stun when target is fully slowed

630.name: rattletrap_jetpack
630.desc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
630.lore: Sure it's blown up over fourteen testing dummies, but at least they all flew!

631.name: life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy
631.lore: Distant memories of the Vile Council fuel one mind to plotting and the other to more immediate dark ends.

632.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo
632.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

641.name: zuus_heavenly_jump
641.desc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
641.lore: Though temporarily barred from the heavens, Zeus can still manage a measure of godly flight.

642.name: alchemist_berserk_potion
642.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
642.lore: After Razzil's great grandfather tested an early version of this potion on himself, a surviving family member immediately saw the profit potential.

643.name: bristleback_hairball
643.desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
643.lore: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.

647.name: rubick_telekinesis_land_self
647.desc: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

648.name: ogre_magi_smash
648.desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
648.lore: There is immense luck involved in Aggron not just setting friends on fire.

649.name: magnataur_horn_toss
649.desc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
649.lore: Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.

650.name: tinker_defense_matrix
650.desc: Targets an allied unit, applying an all damage barrier to them that also provides Status Resistance.
650.lore: A gifted mind unconstrained by moral or ethical boundaries tends to attract an adversary or two.

651.name: shredder_flamethrower
651.desc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
651.lore: A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.

652.name: windrunner_gale_force
652.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
652.lore: At last Lyralei has learned to call upon the might of her true birthright.

656.name: omniknight_hammer_of_purity
656.desc:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

 Omniknight heals for 30% of the damage dealt over 5s.
656.lore: The knight is merely a means to move the hammer.

658.name: special_bonus_unique_batrider_6
658.dname: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm

660.name: dragon_knight_fireball
660.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
660.lore: Most Dragon Knights name no greater horror than the scourge of dragon's fire.

661.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
661.desc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
661.lore: The Rumusque Faithful consider Necrophos to be more plague than person.

662.name: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives
662.desc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
662.lore: A sister is generally given a single name, but powerful names often have plentiful allies.

672.name: special_bonus_unique_bane_7
672.dname: Brain Sap Pure and Pierces Immunity

682.name: storm_spirit_electric_rave
682.desc: Grants Storm Spirit and allied heroes within 750 AoE of him 3 Overload charges. Provides 40 Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.

683.name: visage_silent_as_the_grave
683.desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.
683.lore: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.

687.name: dark_seer_normal_punch
687.desc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.
687.lore: As a young soldier, long before he became a leader of his people, Ish'Kafel was known amongst his fellow recruits as quite the pugilist.

694.name: sniper_concussive_grenade
694.desc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
694.lore: ATTN: IN CASE OF DANGER PULL PIN

699.name: terrorblade_demon_zeal
699.desc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
699.lore: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.

700.name: beastmaster_hawk_dive
700.desc: Flies towards the target enemy, dealing damage and rooting it.

701.name: medusa_cold_blooded
701.desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.
701.lore: Point your gaze at her if you dare.

707.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_whip_debuff_immunity
707.dname: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts

729.name: slark_depth_shroud
729.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
729.lore: Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.

745.name: special_bonus_unique_kunkka_6
745.dname: +{s:bonus_ally_ms}% X Marks the Spot Move Speed

777.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_10
777.dname: Earth Spike affects a 30 degree cone

781.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_11
781.dname: +{s:bonus_spell_amp}% To Hell And Back Debuff/Spell Amp

805.name: special_bonus_unique_underlord_9
805.dname: {s:bonus_dps} DPS in {s:bonus_radius} Radius Around Fiend's Gate

808.name: special_bonus_unique_naga_siren_7
808.dname: Song of the Siren heals allies {s:value}% Max HP/s

814.name: special_bonus_unique_slark_5
814.dname: +{s:bonus_agi_gain} Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack

833.name: skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion
833.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
833.lore: The court mages of Skywrath may only deploy their magic in defense of the kingdom and the throne.

845.name: special_bonus_unique_warlock_10
845.dname: +{s:bonus_aspd_per_second} Upheaval Attack Speed per second on Allies

848.name: special_bonus_unique_luna_8
848.dname: {s:bonus_glaives_fired} Moon Glaives fired on Lucent Beam

860.name: harpy_scout_take_off
860.desc: Harpy Scout gains flying movement at the cost of movement speed. Consumes mana while active.

861.name: kobold_tunneler_prospecting
861.desc: Kobolds are adept at finding gold, increasing nearby allied heroes' GPM.

862.name: furbolg_enrage_attack_speed
862.desc: When Hellbear dies, all nearby allies go into a frenzy gaining attack speed for a short amount of time.

863.name: furbolg_enrage_damage
863.desc: When Hellbear Smasher dies, all nearby allies go into a rampage gaining bonus attack damage for a short amount of time.

864.name: forest_troll_high_priest_heal_amp_aura
864.desc: Provides bonus Heal Amplification to all nearby allies.

865.name: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
865.desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.
865.lore: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.

866.name: enraged_wildkin_hurricane
866.desc: The Wildwing Ripper calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a hurricane that can push a unit in the direction of Wildwing Ripper's choice.

873.name: broodmother_sticky_snare
873.lore: The slightest tremor of her web is all Arachnia needs to find her prey.

875.name: kobold_disarm
875.desc: Every third attack Kobold Soldier will disarm its target temporarily. Attack counter doesn't increase while ability is on cooldown.

876.name: special_bonus_unique_bounty_hunter_6
876.dname: Half Track Bonus Speed to Allies

879.name: techies_sticky_bomb
879.desc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.
879.lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

885.name: ogre_bruiser_ogre_smash
885.desc: Ogre slowly charges a big attack stunning for 2.4 seconds and dealing 200 + 8% of their current HP as damage to all units in front of him.

886.name: techies_reactive_tazer
886.desc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
886.lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

889.name: berserker_troll_break
889.desc: Whenever Hill Troll Berserker attacks a unit it applies break to it.

893.name: hill_troll_rally
893.desc: Skeleton's allies gain bonus attack damage. This Aura stacks.

894.name: giant_wolf_intimidate
894.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious roar reduces all nearby enemies total attack damage.

895.name: omniknight_martyr
895.desc: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.
895.lore: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.

901.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_9
901.dname: +{s:bonus_damage_amp}% Wild Axes Damage Amp Per Stack

902.name: bloodseeker_blood_mist
902.desc:
Bloodseeker sprays his blood continuously in the area around him, losing health to damage and slow his enemies. While active, Sanguivore's healing is increased. Cannot be turned off while on cooldown. 

Additionally, passively turns all your overheal from your own abilities into an all damage barrier up to 50% of Bloodseeker's Max Health. Barrier amount decays by 0.5% per second.

909.name: tinker_warp_grenade
909.desc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
909.lore: Tinker's deadliest weapon instantly turns an enemy into space dust. Research to resolve the annoying 'perfect copy' side effect... is ongoing.

912.name: creep_siege
912.desc: Reinforced Units and Buildings Deal Bonus Damage to other Reinforced Units and Buildings and take less attack damage from other units.

913.name: creep_piercing
913.desc: Piercing Units Deal Bonus Damage to non-hero, non-heavy units and reduced damage to heroes and heavy units.

914.name: creep_irresolute
914.desc: Runty Units Deal reduced damage to hero units.

916.name: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
916.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
916.lore: The only one permitted to harm his more useful followers is Shadow Demon himself.

917.name: special_bonus_unique_elder_titan_bonus_spirit_speed
917.dname: +{s:bonus_move_pct_heroes}% Astral Spirit Bonus Move Speed Per Hero

922.name: ancient_rock_golem_weakening_aura
922.desc: The Rock Golem's imposing figure makes enemies more susceptible to Physical Damage.

923.name: black_drake_magic_amplification_aura
923.desc: The Black Drakes' gaze make enemies more susceptible to Spell Damage.

925.name: special_bonus_unique_legion_commander_8
925.dname: Press the Attack grants {s:bonus_immunity_duration}s Debuff Immunity

932.name: oracle_rain_of_destiny
932.desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
932.lore: Through mixture of the astral and the atmospheric, Nerif bends a single reality into paradoxical alignment.

935.name: warpine_raider_seed_shot
935.desc: Hucks a seed at a target, slowing and damaging it. The seed can bounce multiple times to nearby targets.

936.name: frostbitten_golem_time_warp_aura
936.desc: Coming from a different era, the Frostbitten Golem has an innate control of time, speeding up the cooldowns of all nearby allies.

937.name: ice_shaman_incendiary_bomb
937.desc: The Ice Shaman chucks a blue flame towards an enemy unit or building, dealing damage over time.

942.name: brewmaster_primal_companion
942.desc:
Creates a Brewling based on Brewmaster's current Drunken Brawler Stance.

A new Brewling cannot be resummoned for 3s if the current one takes damage from enemy Heroes or hero-controlled units. If the Brewling dies, the ability goes on cooldown for 70 seconds.

Only one Brewling can exist at a time. If Brewmaster uses Primal Split, the existing Brewling disappears.
942.lore: Mangix doesn't hold to it by rule, but he vaguely recalls an old master musing that, if one could manage, scaring up a companion was always preferable to drinking alone.

943.name: brewmaster_fire_phase
943.desc: Provides the Brewling with phased movement and bonus Status Resistance.

944.name: lina_flame_cloak
944.desc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
944.lore: A natural defense equally suited to keeping anything from unwanted sisters to snarling hellbeasts at bay.

951.name: chen_martyrdom
951.desc: Sacrifice the life of this unit to damage an enemy for 25 + 20% of this unit's current health. Allies may also be targeted for a heal with 50% of the damage value.

952.name: special_bonus_unique_chen_12
952.dname: Hand of God applies a Strong Dispel

953.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone
953.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
953.lore: So convincing that some allies have spent minutes talking to the clone before they realized she wasn't speaking back.

960.name: special_bonus_unique_brewmaster_8
960.dname: +{s:bonus_active_multiplier}% Brewed Up Multiplier for Drunken Brawler

962.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_8
962.dname: Spells deal {s:bonus_bonus_spell_damage} more damage for each Fiery Soul Charge.

980.name: centaur_mount
980.desc: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.
980.lore: The needs of Bradwarden's ample pride pale greatly in the face of his demand for victory.

981.name: enchantress_little_friends
981.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.
981.lore: The laws of the forest may be oblique, but punishment for breaking them is swift and smiling.

983.name: viper_nose_dive
983.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
983.lore: It was thought that Netherdrake wings touch ground only in death, but some surmise that those who've witnessed more intentional landings merely haven't survived to tell the tale.

987.name: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
987.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
987.lore: Barathrum's unyielding focus forms a pocket of planar convergence from which not even the most powerful arcane energies can escape.

992.name: primal_beast_onslaught
992.desc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
992.lore: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.

993.name: primal_beast_onslaught_release
993.desc: Begins the rush to the specified location.

994.name: primal_beast_trample
994.desc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every 140 units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
994.lore: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.

995.name: primal_beast_uproar
995.desc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of 50 hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar. 

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for 7 seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
995.lore: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.

996.name: primal_beast_pulverize
996.desc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts 2.3 seconds.
996.lore: Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.

997.name: furion_curse_of_the_forest
997.desc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
997.lore: Though powerful, Nature's Prophet's gifts do not include all-sight, and he must rely heavily upon reconnaissance and aid from a long-standing network of stalwart friends.

1001.name: shadow_demon_disseminate
1001.desc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
1001.lore: Friends and families share in the suffering when Shadow Demon finds a new victim.

1002.name: special_bonus_unique_alchemist_7
1002.dname: Greevil's Greed provides +{s:bonus_damage} Damage per stack

1005.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
1005.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.
1005.lore: Nature's rage is timeless, and for those who know the secrets, it's easy to stir the echoes of ire that rejoiced in the downfall of Slom.

1008.name: naga_siren_reel_in
1008.desc: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to 5 seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a 1600 range towards her at a speed of 200. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is 100 distance away.
1008.lore: Even the youngest Slithereen are well schooled in trawling for prey with nothing but their wits and nets.

1011.name: special_bonus_unique_troll_warlord_battle_trance_movespeed
1011.dname: Allies Receive Battle Trance Attack Speed

1037.name: special_bonus_unique_magnus_reverse_polarity_stats
1037.dname: +{s:bonus_stats_per_stack} All Attributes per hero hit with Reverse Polarity

1045.name: special_bonus_unique_medusa_7
1045.dname: +{s:bonus_movement_slow}% Mystic Snake Turn and Movement Speed Slow

1048.name: special_bonus_unique_night_stalker_hunter_status_resist
1048.dname: {s:bonus_bonus_status_resist_night}% Hunter in the Night Status Resistance

1060.name: special_bonus_unique_templar_assassin_refraction_disable_cast
1060.dname: Refraction Can Be Cast While Disabled

1063.name: special_bonus_unique_ursa_enrage_radius
1063.dname: Enrage provides half benefits to allies in a {s:bonus_aoe_radius} radius

1064.name: special_bonus_unique_razor_plasmafield_second_ring
1064.dname: Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By {s:bonus_second_ring_delay}s

1086.name: flagbearer_creep_aura_effect
1086.desc: The Flagbearer inspires all allied creeps, granting them bonus health regeneration and magic resistance.

1104.name: nyx_assassin_jolt
1104.desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
1104.lore: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.

1105.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
1105.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
1105.lore: Deep in the heart of the jungles of Jidi, the seeds of extermination freely grow.

1109.name: meepo_megameepo
1109.desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

1110.name: zuus_lightning_hands
1110.desc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
1110.lore: A helping hand from Aghanim lets the fallen Lord of Heaven tap into some of his old strengths.

1116.name: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
1116.desc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.
1116.lore: A powerful solvent that turned out to work all too well.

attrib.header: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK:

1119.name: clinkz_tar_bomb
1119.desc:
Clinkz throws a projectile filled with tar at the target enemy, dealing Magic damage on impact. After impact, the tar spills onto the ground and stays there for 5 seconds. Any enemy that walks across it gets slowed, and attacks from Clinkz or his Skeleton Archers will deal bonus physical damage.

 When the Tar Bomb hits, any Skeleton Archers within attack range will attack the target. If autocast is activated, Clinkz will throw a tar bomb when attacking the target, if it is available.
1119.lore: After his battle with Maraxiform, Clinkz found a useful source of ichor where his heart used to be.

1120.name: clinkz_strafe
1120.desc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus. 

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
1120.lore: The closest Clinkz can come to peace is knowing that this was the last thing Maraxiform ever saw.

1121.name: drow_ranger_glacier
1121.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
1121.lore: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

1130.name: special_bonus_unique_enchantress_enchant_health_damage
1130.dname: +{s:bonus_bonus_health} Health / +{s:bonus_bonus_damage} Damage  for Enchantress and her units

1132.name: special_bonus_unique_primal_beast_trample_unslowable
1132.dname: Cannot be slowed or rooted during Trample

1135.name: centaur_work_horse
1135.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
1135.lore: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.

1136.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally
1136.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
1136.lore: Useful for the rare instances when a contested bounty is actually wanted alive.

1143.name: antimage_counterspell_ally
1143.desc: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.
1143.lore: The only magic that Anti-Mage will even barely tolerate... is friendship.

1166.name: axe_one_man_army
1166.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

1173.name: seasonal_party_hat
1173.desc: CHANNELED. Steals an enemy hero's stack of Frostivus hats, or gives your stack to an allied hero.

1174.name: special_bonus_unique_enchantress_enchant_armor
1174.dname: +{s:bonus_bonus_armor} Armor for Enchantress and her units

1178.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_dragon_slave_crits
1178.dname: +{s:bonus_target_crit_multiplier}% Crit On Targets Affected By Dragon Slave

1181.name: special_bonus_unique_ogre_magi_dumb_luck_mana
1181.dname: +{s:bonus_mana_per_str}/{s:bonus_mana_regen_per_str} Dumb Luck Mana/Mana Regen Per Strength

1182.name: special_bonus_unique_oracle_damage_per_purge
1182.dname: Fortune's End Heals/Damages for {s:bonus_damage_per_buff} Per Effect Dispelled

1189.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_culling_blade_speed_duration
1189.dname: +{s:bonus_speed_duration}s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration

1197.name: special_bonus_unique_vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror_steal
1197.dname: Wave Of Terror Steals {s:bonus_steal_pct}% Of Reduced Damage And Armor

1200.name: warlock_imp_explode
1200.desc: Shortly after dying, a burst of magic damage is dealt to all enemies in a small area. Does 50% less damage to non-hero targets.

1202.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
1202.desc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

1203.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
1203.desc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.

1205.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
1205.desc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.
1205.lore: Traxex' time spent alone in the forests of her Drow home has allowed her to teach other archers how to improve their bow skills.

1209.name: juggernaut_duelist
1209.desc: Juggernaut deals 12% more damage to targets that are facing him. Damage bonus always applies during Omnislash.

1210.name: juggernaut_bladeform
1210.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

1213.name: mirana_invis
1213.desc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
1213.lore: Her tenure with Selemene allows Mirana to eclipse the ground, wrapping her allies in a cloak of shadows.

1214.name: mirana_solar_flare
1214.desc:
Gradually increases attack speed and damage of Mirana and all allied heroes, reaching maximum power after 6s. 

 Allies receive 50% of the bonus.

1215.name: mirana_selemenes_faithful
1215.desc: Healing Lotuses are 50% more effective on Mirana and her allies.

1216.name: nevermore_frenzy
1216.desc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
1216.lore: For Nevermore, there's as much delight in the harvest as there is in the feast.

1217.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_frenzy_castspeed
1217.dname: Feast of Souls Grants +{s:bonus_cast_speed_pct}% Cast Speed

1218.name: morphling_ebb
1218.desc: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now Agility.

1219.name: morphling_flow
1219.desc: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now Strength. Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength. Morphling gains 1% Spell Amp per 4 Agility.

1220.name: morphling_accumulation
1220.desc: Morphling receives 50% of stat growth bonuses every half level instead of the full bonus at level up. All Attributes bonuses from skill points in the Talent Tree provide an additional +3 to Morphling's primary attribute.

attrib.header: BONUS PRIMARY STAT PER LEVEL OF ATTRIBUTES:
BONUS INT PER LEVEL OF ATTRIBUTES:

1221.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
1221.desc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
1221.lore: Azwraith knows that on the field of battle, speed can mean everything.

1222.name: puck_puckish
1222.desc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

1223.name: pudge_innate_graft_flesh
1223.desc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 1.6 bonus Strength for each stack.

1224.name: razor_storm_surge
1224.desc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
1224.lore: Merely approaching the Lightning Revenant is rewarded with shock therapy.

attrib.header: HIT TARGETS INSIDE EYE OF THE STORM:
EYE OF THE STORM CHANCE MULTIPLIER:

1226.name: sandking_caustic_finale
1226.desc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
1226.lore: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.

1229.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
1229.desc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
1229.lore: Crixalis is certainly capable of mercy, but the soul of the sand finds few foes worth sparing.

1231.name: storm_spirit_galvanized
1231.desc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.

1232.name: sven_vanquisher
1232.desc: Sven's attacks deal 20% bonus damage to stunned enemies.

1234.name: sven_wrath_of_god
1234.desc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

1236.name: tiny_insurmountable
1236.desc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.

1237.name: vengefulspirit_soul_strike
1237.desc: Vengeful Spirit's ranged attacks behave as if they were melee attacks.

1238.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
1238.desc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

1239.name: windrunner_easy_breezy
1239.desc: Windranger's movement speed cannot be lower than 240 and can reach 600.

1244.name: lina_slow_burn
1244.desc: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

1245.name: lich_death_charge
1245.desc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.

1249.name: lion_to_hell_and_back
1249.desc:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

1250.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
1250.desc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
1250.lore: Rhasta had to learn early on how to stay one step ahead of those who (rightfully or wrongfully) wished him harm.

attrib.header: ALLY CHICKEN IMAGES TAKE DAMAGE PERCENT:

1253.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
1253.desc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.

1255.name: tidehunter_blubber
1255.desc:
Tidehunter's hide removes negative status effects if he takes more than 450 damage. Removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

1257.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris
1257.desc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s. 

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

attrib.header: DEATH GOLD LOST REDUCTION PCT TOOLTIP:

1258.name: riki_innate_backstab
1258.desc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.

1259.name: enigma_gravity_well
1259.desc: Allies within 500 distance from Enigma have up to 9% Damage Reduction. Effect starts at 0% at max distance and increases to its maximum strength when the ally is at 200 distance. Does not affect Enigma itself.

1260.name: enigma_splitting_image
1260.desc: Enigma spawns Eidolons upon receiving damage.

1261.name: enigma_event_horizon
1261.desc: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

1262.name: tinker_eureka
1262.desc: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.

1268.name: sniper_keen_scope
1268.desc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.

1270.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
1270.desc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
1270.lore: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.

attrib.header: ENEMIES NEGATIVE HEAL BONUS AS PCT OF SELF:

1271.name: warlock_golem_flaming_fists
1271.desc: Deals extra damage to nearby units when attacking.

1272.name: warlock_golem_permanent_immolation
1272.desc: Burns the Golem's nearby enemy units, dealing damage per second.

1274.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
1274.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

1276.name: queenofpain_masochist
1276.desc: Queen of Pain has bonus Spell Amplification but a percentage of her spell damage is reflected back to her.

1277.name: queenofpain_succubus
1277.desc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.

1278.name: queenofpain_bondage
1278.desc: Whenever an enemy within 1200 range deals spell damage to Queen of Pain, she returns 20% of the damage dealt.

1279.name: special_bonus_unique_queen_of_pain_1
1279.dname: +{s:bonus_attack_speed} Attack Speed against Shadow Striked units

1280.name: faceless_void_distortion_field
1280.desc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get within 500 distance of their target.

1281.name: faceless_void_time_zone
1281.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, cast, projectile, cooldown, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and cooldown acceleration. Enemies have decreased speed, and have frozen ability and item cooldowns. Does not affect Ultimate abilities. Time Dilation does not tick down while inside.
1281.lore: For the Acolytes of Clasz, stopping time is trivial, but manipulating the minutiae of its flow requires a mastery few have attained.

1282.name: skeleton_king_spectral_blade
1282.desc: Curses units that Wraith King attacks, dealing a flat amount of damage and a percentage of the attack damage again after a delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage and a unit cannot be cursed again for a short period of time.
1282.lore: The eternal spite of every soul stolen by Ostarion bleeds into reality with each strike of his murderous blade.

1283.name: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
1283.desc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.

1285.name: death_prophet_spirit_collector
1285.desc: Hero deaths empower your next Exorcism.

1287.name: phantom_assassin_immaterial
1287.desc:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks. Evasion improves with Phantom Assassin's levels. 

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

1288.name: pugna_oblivion_savant
1288.desc:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

1293.name: dazzle_innate_weave
1293.desc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
1293.lore: His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.

1295.name: rattletrap_armor_power
1295.desc:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

1296.name: leshrac_chronoptic_nourishment
1296.desc: Leshrac restores mana equal to 25% of damage dealt by his attacks. Only grants mana when attacking enemies that have mana. 50% mana restoration penalty when attacking creeps.

1298.name: furion_spirit_of_the_forest
1298.desc: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values and with larger radius. Treants also possess this ability.

1301.name: life_stealer_unfettered
1301.desc:
Descend into a violent fury, gaining increased status and magic resistance. Applies a dispel and can be cast while disabled.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

1303.name: dark_seer_quick_wit
1303.desc: Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

1304.name: dark_seer_heart_of_battle
1304.desc: Dark Seer moves faster when near other heroes.

1305.name: dark_seer_mental_fortitude
1305.desc: Dark Seer's Intelligence cannot be lower than the average of his Strength and Agility.

1306.name: clinkz_bone_and_arrow
1306.desc: Clinkz summons a Skeleton Archer when he dies.

1307.name: omniknight_healing_hammer
1307.desc: Ability damage done to enemies by Omniknight heals him over time.

1309.name: huskar_blood_magic
1309.desc: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

1310.name: night_stalker_heart_of_darkness
1310.desc: Night Stalker's health regeneration is increased during the night and decreased during the day.

1313.name: broodmother_spiders_milk
1313.desc: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

1314.name: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss
1314.desc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.
1314.lore: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.

1315.name: bounty_hunter_cutpurse
1315.desc: Bounty Hunter steals 4 gold when targeting enemy heroes with his abilities or items.

1316.name: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter
1316.desc: Bounty Hunter receives 15% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

1317.name: jakiro_liquid_ice
1317.desc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
1317.lore: The right maw of Jakiro opens, punishing all with bitter frost.

1318.name: jakiro_double_trouble
1318.desc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.

1319.name: batrider_smoldering_resin
1319.desc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

1323.name: spectre_spectral
1323.desc:
When targeting a unit for attack, Spectre gains phased collision. If she moves through a unit, she gains 40 movement speed. This effect lingers for 0.3s.

Spectre's illusions always have phased collision, and cannot gain the speed bonus.

1324.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
1324.desc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 15% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.

1327.name: ursa_maul
1327.desc: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

1328.name: ursa_bear_down
1328.desc: Debuffs inflicted by Ursa last longer.

1330.name: spirit_breaker_herd_mentality
1330.desc: The hero on your team whose level is lower than anybody else's on your team gains 50% more experience.

1333.name: alchemist_goblins_greed
1333.desc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
1333.lore: While it is not a mountain, Razzil has mastered the conversion of smaller compounds to line his pockets.

1334.name: invoker_mastermind
1334.desc: When Invoker denies a lane creep, he gets 25% of the XP.

1335.name: silencer_brain_drain
1335.desc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.

1338.name: obsidian_destroyer_ominous_discernment
1338.desc: Outworld Destroyer gains an additional 2.5 mana per point of Intelligence.

1339.name: lycan_apex_predator
1339.desc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

1340.name: shadow_demon_shadow_servant
1340.desc:
Shadow Demon and his illusions' attacks reduce the current health of the target by 1% per stack. When the effect expires, the target regains 50% of the lost health.

If an enemy Hero dies under this effect, Shadow Demon creates an illusion of them that lasts until the Hero respawns or Shadow Demon dies.

1341.name: shadow_demon_menace
1341.desc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.

1342.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear
1342.desc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
1342.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.

1343.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear_return
1343.desc: Channels for 3 seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.

1344.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear_entangle
1344.desc:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

1347.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear_fetch
1347.desc: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every 0.5s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

1348.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear_demolish
1348.desc: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.

1352.name: chaos_knight_phantasmagoria
1352.desc: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.

1353.name: chaos_knight_reins_of_chaos
1353.desc: Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a 50% chance that an additional 1 extra illusion will spawn.

1355.name: meepo_pack_rat
1355.desc: All Meepos can use the item in the neutral item slot.

1356.name: meepo_sticky_fingers
1356.desc: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.

1360.name: undying_ceaseless_dirge
1360.lore: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.

1361.name: rubick_might_and_magus
1361.desc: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

1362.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
1362.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
1362.lore: For a brief moment, it's as if the wind itself had turned solid.

1363.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
1363.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.
1363.lore: Safe harbor found inside the storm.

1365.name: nyx_assassin_nyxth_sense
1365.desc: Nyx Assassin can detect heroes within 400 units of himself.

1369.name: naga_siren_deluge
1369.desc: Naga Siren and all of her images hit nearby units with a damaging wave of water that caps their max movement speed.
1369.lore: There's no use trying to run through deep water.

1370.name: naga_siren_eelskin
1370.desc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

1372.name: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
1372.desc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
1372.lore: Even a glimpse of the First Light is enough to rob enemies of their senses.

1379.name: centaur_horsepower
1379.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains 30% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

1382.name: magnataur_solid_core
1382.desc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

1383.name: shredder_twisted_chakram
1383.desc: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing.
1383.lore: A happy little accident in the lab turned wild new weapon in the forest.

1384.name: shredder_exposure_therapy
1384.desc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

1385.name: tusk_drinking_buddies
1385.desc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor. Can be put on alt-cast to only pull Tusk towards his ally with 50% reduced cast range.
1385.lore: The only thing better than finding a good drinking buddy is finding an equally good enemy the two of you can punch.

1386.name: tusk_bitter_chill
1386.desc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.

1387.name: skywrath_mage_staff_of_the_scion
1387.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magic damage to an enemy hero with an ability, he reduces all his ability cooldowns by 0.1s.
1387.lore: To raise the ire of Skywrath is to invite retribution that strikes like a storm.

1392.name: elder_titan_ancestral_spirit
1392.desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
1392.lore: Like the four fundamentals, Elder Titan exists across all planes at once and can draw other aspects of himself to assist in times of need.

1393.name: elder_titan_momentum
1393.desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

1395.name: earth_spirit_stone_caller
1395.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 2.5% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
1395.lore: Earth Spirit calls forth a remnant of his stone army, long buried with him in the dark embrace of the Earth.

1396.name: terrorblade_dark_unity
1396.desc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.

1397.name: phoenix_dying_light
1397.desc: Phoenix deals 4% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a 400 radius every second.

1398.name: phoenix_blinding_sun
1398.desc: Phoenix ability debuffs apply a stackable 0% Miss chance per second. Lasts 0 seconds.

1399.name: oracle_clairvoyant_curse
1399.desc: Spell amplification increased by 1% per hero level.

1400.name: oracle_clairvoyant_cure
1400.desc: Heal amplification increased by 0.75% per hero level.

1402.name: techies_squees_scope
1402.desc: Techies gains 1 attack range and attack projectile speed for each point of attack speed.

1403.name: techies_spoons_stash
1403.desc: Techies stack all previously selected Enchantments onto newly crafted Neutral Items.

1404.name: winter_wyvern_eldwurm_scholar
1404.desc: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within 1200 of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to 25% of the ultimate's manacost.

1405.name: winter_wyvern_essence_of_the_blueheart
1405.desc: Winter Wyvern's heals also restore mana.

1406.name: winter_wyvern_dragon_sight
1406.desc: Winter Wyvern gains bonus damage when her attack range is over 400.

1407.name: arc_warden_runic_infusion
1407.desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

1408.name: abyssal_underlord_abyssal_horde
1408.desc:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every 2s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

1409.name: abyssal_underling_warrior_last_will
1409.desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

1410.name: abyssal_underling_warrior_mana_burn
1410.desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

1412.name: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
1412.desc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.

1413.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust
1413.desc: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

attrib.header: HP REGEN AMP OUT OF WORLD:
MANA REGEN AMP OUT OF WORLD:

1414.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
1414.desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4s.

1415.name: mars_dauntless
1415.desc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in 700 radius.

1416.name: mars_arena_of_blood
1416.desc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
1416.lore: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.

1417.name: special_bonus_unique_mars_arena_of_blood_hp_regen
1417.dname: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +{s:bonus_health_regen} HP Regen

1419.name: void_spirit_symmetry
1419.desc: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.

1420.name: void_spirit_intrinsic_edge
1420.desc: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

1421.name: snapfire_buckshot
1421.desc: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals 30% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a 25% chance of a glancing shot, dealing 60% damage.

1422.name: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang
1422.desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
1422.lore: A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.

1424.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn
1424.desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.

1427.name: marci_bodyguard
1427.desc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with 75% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, 30% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
1427.lore: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

1428.name: marci_special_delivery
1428.desc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
1428.lore: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.

1430.name: special_bonus_unique_marci_unleash_extend_duration
1430.dname: Unleash Duration Extended By 6s On Kill

1435.name: muerta_ofrenda
1435.desc:
Muerta places a sacred altar at the targeted location that increases her attack speed when she is near it.

When respawning, Muerta will gain the benefits of Pierce The Veil's corporeal form for 50% of the duration and respawn at the Ofrenda.

Muerta can select the Ofrenda and force it to destroy itself. Only one Ofrenda can exist at a time.

1437.name: muerta_ofrenda_destroy
1437.desc: Destroy this Ofrenda, ensuring that Muerta will respawn in the fountain.

1438.name: special_bonus_unique_muerta_calling_hp_regen
1438.dname: +{s:bonus_hp_regen_pct}% Max HP Regen while inside The Calling

1442.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_crit_debuff
1442.dname: 150% Attack Crit On Targets Affected By Slow Burn

1447.name: antimage_persectur
1447.desc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 50% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 50% mana.

1448.name: earthshaker_spirit_cairn
1448.desc: When Earthshaker dies, a 75 radius fissure is created where he died. This fissure blocks movement and allows Earthshaker to continue to gain experience around it. It remains until Earthshaker respawns.

1449.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
1449.desc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.

1454.name: lina_combustion
1454.desc: Every 175 damage Lina does to an enemy hero causes them to overheat, doing damage to their nearby allies. This effect can trigger multiple times off a single instance of damage. Overheated illusions do less damage.

1456.name: beastmaster_rugged
1456.desc: Beastmaster's melee hero Damage Block Chance is increased from 50% to 100% versus non-hero units and non-building units.

1457.name: venomancer_sepsis
1457.desc: Venomancer's attacks deal extra damage based on how many debuffs the attack target has. Extra damage is dealt as magical damage. Only counts debuffs from Venomancer or his Plague Wards.

1460.name: templar_assassin_third_eye
1460.desc: Templar Assassin and her teammates can see Roshan's respawn timer.

1462.name: luna_lunar_orbit
1462.desc: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
1462.lore: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.

attrib.header: ROTATING GLAIVES MOVEMENT RADIUS EXPAND SPEED SCALE:
ROTATING GLAIVE COLLISION SPEED DAMAGE TOOLTIP:

1464.name: enchantress_rabblerouser
1464.desc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.

1465.name: weaver_rewoven
1465.desc: Every time Weaver damages an enemy hero with an ability, he gains 6 experience.

1469.name: lycan_summon_wolves_hamstring
1469.desc: The wolf bites down on an enemy's hamstring, rooting them for a short duration. After the bite, the next 4 attacks from units controlled by Lycan deal bonus damage.

1470.name: lycan_summon_wolves_hightail
1470.desc: The wolf gains a short burst of energy, gaining phased movement, evasion, hasted movement speed, and attack speed.

1472.name: lone_druid_gift_bearer
1472.desc: Lone Druid's Spirit Bear receives a copy of his Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

1473.name: lone_druid_bear_necessities
1473.desc: Lone Druid can only use the first 3 items in his inventory. These items' passive bonuses are more powerful. Other item slots do not provide any bonuses. Neutral slot is unaffected.

1474.name: visage_lurker
1474.desc:
Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every 2s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants 2% cooldown acceleration with a max of 8 stacks. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

1475.name: medusa_gorgon_grasp
1475.desc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
1475.lore: The best predators don't even need to pounce.

1478.name: troll_warlord_switch_stance
1478.desc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.
1478.lore: Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.

1479.name: bristleback_prickly
1479.desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

1481.name: abaddon_withering_mist
1481.desc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 24.5% if they are below 40% HP.

1482.name: elder_titan_tip_the_scales
1482.desc: Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal 100% bonus damage.

1483.name: legion_commander_outfight_them
1483.desc:
Passively grants Legion Commander armor.

If Legion or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.

1484.name: ember_spirit_immolation
1484.desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.

1485.name: special_bonus_unique_arc_warden_flux_silences
1485.dname: Flux Silences when target is alone

1486.name: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss
1486.desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

1493.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_dagger_bleed_and_slow_duration
1493.dname: +1s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration

1494.name: earthshaker_slugger
1494.desc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

attrib.header: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE:

1497.name: kez_switch_weapons
1497.desc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
1497.lore: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.

1498.name: kez_echo_slash
1498.desc: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100s impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
1498.lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.

1499.name: kez_grappling_claw
1499.desc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree. When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
1499.lore: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.

1500.name: kez_kazurai_katana
1500.desc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. 

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
1500.lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.

1501.name: kez_raptor_dance
1501.desc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
1501.lore: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.

1502.name: kez_falcon_rush
1502.desc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks. While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
1502.lore: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.

1503.name: kez_talon_toss
1503.desc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
1503.lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.

1504.name: kez_shodo_sai
1504.desc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 2 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
1504.lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.

1506.name: kez_ravens_veil
1506.desc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
1506.lore: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.

1521.name: special_bonus_unique_kez_ravens_veil_mark_parry_bonus
1521.dname: Raven's Veil Mark Applies Parry Bonus

1527.name: frogmen_riverborn_aura
1527.desc: Whenever the Frog is in water, it increases all allied movement speed and outgoing damage.

1528.name: frogmen_arm_of_the_deep
1528.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

1529.name: frogmen_tendrils_of_the_deep
1529.desc: Sends out a cone-shaped slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

1530.name: frogmen_congregation_of_the_deep
1530.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in all directions, stunning and damaging enemies.

1531.name: frogmen_water_bubble_small
1531.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s.

1532.name: frogmen_water_bubble_medium
1532.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target for 50% of the absorb amount.

1533.name: frogmen_water_bubble_large
1533.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target and all allies in the radius for 50% of the absorb amount.

1541.name: special_bonus_unique_enchantress_enchant_attackspeed
1541.dname: +{s:bonus_bonus_attackspeed} Attack Speed for Enchantress and her units
