1544.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo_hands
1544.desc: Your next attack on an enemy hero transforms them into a chicken for 1s.
1544.lore: Even a brief moment as a chicken is long enough to make most would-be aggressors rethink their mark.

1550.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
1550.desc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
1550.lore: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.

1551.name: dazzle_nothl_projection_end
1551.desc: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

1553.name: dark_seer_aggrandize
1553.desc:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

1554.name: jakiro_ice_path_detonate
1554.desc: Destroy the Ice Path, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

1558.name: keeper_of_the_light_special_reserve
1558.desc: Keeper of the Light cannot go below 75 mana.

1560.name: medusa_undulation
1560.desc: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at 310 (465 during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.

1563.name: special_bonus_unique_timbersaw_exposure_therapy_health
1563.dname: Exposure Therapy Heals for {s:bonus_health_restore} HP Per Tree Destroyed

1571.name: special_bonus_unique_dawnbreaker_gleaming_hammer
1571.dname: Celestial Hammer emits Solar Guardian aura

1624.name: silencer_oppressive_silence
1624.desc: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

1626.name: wisp_essence_conduction
1626.desc: Io regenerates from consumables and the fountain 2x faster.

1627.name: monkey_king_transfiguration
1627.desc: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a 1.5s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

1656.name: special_bonus_unique_kez_talon_toss_attack_factor
1656.dname: Add {s:bonus_attack_factor}% of Attack Damage to Talon Toss

1659.name: largo_catchy_lick
1659.desc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
1659.lore: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.

1660.name: largo_frogstomp
1660.desc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
1660.lore: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.

1661.name: largo_croak_of_genius
1661.desc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
1661.lore: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.

1662.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
1662.desc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
1662.lore: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.

attrib.header: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:

1663.name: largo_song_fight_song
1663.desc: Largo plays a song that deals 20 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
1663.lore: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'

1664.name: largo_song_double_time
1664.desc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
1664.lore: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'

1665.name: largo_song_good_vibrations
1665.desc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
1665.lore: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'

1666.name: largo_encore
1666.desc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.

1678.name: clinkz_infernal_shred
1678.desc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%. 

Lasts 5 seconds.

1679.name: spectre_shadow_step
1679.desc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
1679.lore: With great focus of will, Mercurial can sometimes limit the extent of her division.

1680.name: brewmaster_drunken_brawler_brew_up
1680.desc: Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up and his stance becomes empowered. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended. The cooldown starts when the effect ends.

1681.name: brewmaster_liquid_courage
1681.desc: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.

1683.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear_spirit_link
1683.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
1683.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

1684.name: lone_druid_entangle
1684.desc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.

1690.name: special_bonus_unique_lone_druid_spirit_bear_return_cd
1690.dname: Return has No Cooldown and -0.5s Channel Time

1691.name: treant_super_bloom
1691.desc: Treant grows massive in size for 15 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 310, 120% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.

1692.name: visage_summon_familiars_recall
1692.desc: Recall this familiar to Visage after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

1693.name: slark_saltwater_shiv
1693.desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

1701.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_smash_on_blubber
1701.dname: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash

1702.name: special_bonus_unique_riki_tricks_dmg
1702.dname: {s:bonus_base_attack_damage_pct}% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade

1704.name: special_bonus_unique_broodmother_web_speed
1704.dname: +{s:bonus_bonus_movespeed}% Spin Web Move Speed and Ignore Speed Limit

1707.name: special_bonus_unique_brewmaster_brewed_up_duration
1707.dname: +{s:bonus_brewed_up_duration}/{s:bonus_brewed_up_duration_extend}s Drunken Brawler Brew Up / Extend Duration

1714.name: special_bonus_unique_kez_falcon_rush_attack_speed
1714.dname: {s:bonus_bonus_attack_speed} Bonus Attack Speed During Falcon Rush

1735.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard
1735.desc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

1739.name: mirana_celestial_quiver
1739.desc:
When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.

Gains a charge every 7 hero levels.

1740.name: morphling_syntropy
1740.desc:
Morphling's attacks have increased attack range, slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

 If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum Attack Speed slow is applied. 

If Morphling's Strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum Movement Speed slow is applied.

1741.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
1741.desc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.

1742.name: windrunner_tailwind
1742.desc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

1743.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
1743.desc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.

1749.name: venomancer_snakebite
1749.desc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

1750.name: templar_assassin_inner_peace
1750.desc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.25s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 2.05s of meditating.

1752.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
1752.desc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
1752.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

1754.name: weaver_threads_of_fate
1754.desc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

1756.name: ancient_apparition_bone_chill
1756.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

1757.name: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
1757.desc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

1759.name: gyrocopter_afterburner
1759.desc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

1760.name: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
1760.desc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

1763.name: meepo_geomancy
1763.desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.

1765.name: rubick_curiosity
1765.desc:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus. 

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.

1767.name: nyx_assassin_neuro_sting
1767.desc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

1768.name: naga_siren_slithereen_cutlass
1768.desc: Naga Siren's attacks add a stacking debuff that causes the target to miss attacks for 6 seconds, up to a max of 10 stacks.

1769.name: keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed
1769.desc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 2.5 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.

1770.name: wisp_equilibrium
1770.desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

1771.name: bristleback_brawlers_grit
1771.desc: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for 8s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.

1775.name: special_bonus_unique_phoenix_dying_light_damage
1775.dname: +1% Dying Light Missing Health as Damage

1777.name: techies_snare_trap
1777.desc: Plant an invisible trap that, when triggered by a player-controlled target, does a small amount of damage over time and slows enemy cast speed. Affected units are also tethered inside of the trap radius. Snare Traps take 2 seconds to activate and last for up to 300 seconds.

1778.name: techies_mutually_assured_destruction
1778.desc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.

1780.name: winter_wyvern_accelerated_learning
1780.desc: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

1781.name: mars_immovable
1781.desc: Mars cannot be affected by forced movement.

1782.name: snapfire_boomstick
1782.desc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

1783.name: hoodwink_tomokan_tracker
1783.desc: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last 15 seconds in a 1200 area around her.

1786.name: special_bonus_unique_crystal_maiden_glacial_guard_mana_multiplier
1786.dname: +{s:bonus_mana_multiplier}% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier

1789.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_frenzy_max_collection_count
1789.dname: +{s:bonus_soul_collection_per_hero} Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero

1790.name: special_bonus_unique_sven_stormhammer_cooldown
1790.dname: -{s:bonus_AbilityCooldown}% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost

1794.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_maledict_spread
1794.dname: Maledict bursts deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% damage in a {s:bonus_spread_radius} AoE

1798.name: special_bonus_unique_necrophos_reaper_scythe_damage_per_health
1798.dname: +{s:bonus_damage_per_health} Reaper's Scythe Damage Per Missing HP

1810.name: special_bonus_unique_death_prophet_exorcism_duration_on_kill
1810.dname: Deaths During Exorcism Extend Duration By +{s:bonus_duration_increase_per_kill}s

1823.name: special_bonus_unique_alchemist_weaponry_power
1823.dname: +{s:bonus_slow_per_stack}% Corrosive Weaponry Slow / Damage Reduction Per Stack

1824.name: special_bonus_unique_silencer_brain_drain_damage
1824.dname: +{s:bonus_damage_pct}% Suffer In Silence Silenced Target Damage

1834.name: special_bonus_unique_tusk_shard_dps
1834.dname: Ice Shards slow by {s:bonus_aghs_shard_move_slow}% and deal {s:bonus_aghs_shard_damage} DPS

1836.name: special_bonus_unique_elder_titan_momentum_attack_speed
1836.dname: {s:bonus_attack_speed_from_movespeed}% of Bonus Movement Speed as Attack Speed

1841.name: special_bonus_unique_techies_tazer_duration
1841.dname: +{s:bonus_duration}% Reactive Tazer Buff and Disarm Duration

4646.name: tinker_keen_teleport
4646.desc: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.
4646.lore: As Boush likes to say, 'There is nothing the arcane can accomplish that the curious mind cannot reproduce given time. And proper funding, of course.'

5003.name: antimage_mana_break
5003.desc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
5003.lore: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.

5004.name: antimage_blink
5004.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
5004.lore: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.

5006.name: antimage_mana_void
5006.desc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies. The main target is also mini-stunned.
5006.lore: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.

5007.name: axe_berserkers_call
5007.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
5007.lore: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.

5008.name: axe_battle_hunger
5008.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
5008.lore: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.

5009.name: axe_counter_helix
5009.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
5009.lore: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.

5010.name: axe_culling_blade
5010.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
5010.lore: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.

5011.name: bane_brain_sap
5011.desc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
5011.lore: Atropos finds no greater pleasure than to harvest the fear he creates.

5012.name: bane_enfeeble
5012.desc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
5012.lore: Each tendril of fear that Atropos weaves increases the vulnerability of his victims to arcane and unknown arts.

5013.name: bane_fiends_grip
5013.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
5013.lore: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.

5014.name: bane_nightmare
5014.desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
5014.lore: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.

5015.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
5015.desc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
5015.lore: Strygwyr shares his animalistic thirst for bloodshed.

5016.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
5016.desc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
5016.lore: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.

5017.name: bloodseeker_thirst
5017.desc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
5017.lore: Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.

5018.name: bloodseeker_rupture
5018.desc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
5018.lore: When the Bloodseeker hunts you, injuries become fatalities.

5019.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
5019.desc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage. Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.
5019.lore: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.

5022.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
5022.desc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 325 range.
5022.lore: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.

5023.name: earthshaker_fissure
5023.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
5023.lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.

5024.name: earthshaker_enchant_totem
5024.desc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.
5024.lore: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.

5025.name: earthshaker_aftershock
5025.desc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
5025.lore: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.

5026.name: earthshaker_echo_slam
5026.desc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units. Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
5026.lore: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.

5027.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
5027.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
5027.lore: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

5028.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
5028.desc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
5028.lore: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.

5029.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
5029.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 seconds.
5029.lore: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.

5030.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
5030.desc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5030.lore: 'The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.'

5031.name: kunkka_torrent
5031.desc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
5031.lore: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.

5032.name: kunkka_tidebringer
5032.desc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
5032.lore: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.

5033.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
5033.desc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
5033.lore: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.

5034.name: kunkka_return
5034.desc: Returns the marked hero to the X.

5035.name: kunkka_ghostship
5035.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
5035.lore: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.

5040.name: lina_dragon_slave
5040.desc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
5040.lore: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.

5041.name: lina_light_strike_array
5041.desc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
5041.lore: Lina's essence allows her to focus the sun's energies, causing air to combust at will.

5042.name: lina_fiery_soul
5042.desc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 18 seconds.
5042.lore: Dancing flames embody Lina's playful nature, bringing out her true blazing self.

5043.name: lina_laguna_blade
5043.desc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
5043.lore: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that comes too close with white-hot lightning.

5044.name: lion_impale
5044.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
5044.lore: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.

5045.name: lion_voodoo
5045.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
5045.lore: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.

5046.name: lion_mana_drain
5046.desc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. 

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.
5046.lore: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.

5047.name: lion_finger_of_death
5047.desc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. 

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
5047.lore: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.

5048.name: mirana_arrow
5048.desc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.6 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
5048.lore: Lunar energies make the Princess of the Moon's arrows more deadly than most.

5050.name: mirana_leap
5050.desc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts 5 seconds.
5050.lore: None can fail to recognize Mirana's iconic white beast in the heat of battle.

5051.name: mirana_starfall
5051.desc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a 675 radius will be struck a second time.
5051.lore: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.

5052.name: morphling_waveform
5052.desc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
5052.lore: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.

5053.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
5053.desc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier. If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
5053.lore: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.

5055.name: morphling_morph_agi
5055.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of 4. The process is reversible.
5055.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.

5056.name: morphling_morph_str
5056.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of 4. The process is reversible.
5056.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.

5057.name: morphling_replicate
5057.desc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
5057.lore: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.

5058.name: morphling_morph_replicate
5058.desc: Toggles Morphling's form between his own and the replicated enemy.

5059.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
5059.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

5060.name: nevermore_shadowraze2
5060.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

5061.name: nevermore_shadowraze3
5061.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

5062.name: nevermore_necromastery
5062.desc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1.35 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30% of them from bondage.
5062.lore: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.

attrib.header: MAX SOUL INCREASE ON HERO KILL:

5063.name: nevermore_dark_lord
5063.desc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
5063.lore: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.

5064.name: nevermore_requiem
5064.desc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
5064.lore: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.

5065.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
5065.desc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
5065.lore: Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.

5066.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
5066.desc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After 1 second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes 500% bonus damage and deals -80% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5066.lore: Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.

attrib.header: HP MISSING PER EXTRA ILLUSION PCT:

5067.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
5067.desc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
5067.lore: Each of Azwraith's lance attacks feels like two from a normal warrior; or three; or four...

5069.name: puck_illusory_orb
5069.desc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional 3% of its impact damage every 0.5s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

 Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
5069.lore: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.

attrib.header: CURVE ORB PULLBACK BONUS LAUNCH SPEED:

5070.name: puck_ethereal_jaunt
5070.desc: Teleports Puck to a flying Illusory Orb.
5070.lore: The Orb is an egg of potential, traveling along its own timeline.

5071.name: puck_waning_rift
5071.desc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
5071.lore: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.

5072.name: puck_phase_shift
5072.desc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
5072.lore: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.

5073.name: puck_dream_coil
5073.desc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them. If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
5073.lore: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.

5074.name: pudge_flesh_heap
5074.desc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
5074.lore: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'

5075.name: pudge_meat_hook
5075.desc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
5075.lore: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.

5076.name: pudge_rot
5076.desc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
5076.lore: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.

5077.name: pudge_dismember
5077.desc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.
5077.lore: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'

5078.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
5078.desc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
5078.lore: Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.

5079.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
5079.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
5079.lore: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.

5080.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
5080.desc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
5080.lore: A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.

5081.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
5081.desc: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
5081.lore: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shaman's act; now Rhasta can empower the snakes to do his bidding.

5082.name: razor_plasma_field
5082.desc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
5082.lore: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

5083.name: razor_static_link
5083.desc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
5083.lore: Razor's polarity channels electricity into his being, draining the power of his opposition.

5085.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
5085.desc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.

5086.name: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
5086.desc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
5086.lore: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.

5087.name: skeleton_king_bone_guard
5087.desc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
5087.lore: Wraith King's blade drains his enemy's essence to feed his aura.

5088.name: skeleton_king_mortal_strike
5088.desc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
5088.lore: One blow to crush a foe.

5089.name: skeleton_king_reincarnation
5089.desc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle. Upon death, enemy units in a 600 radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
5089.lore: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.

5090.name: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
5090.desc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
5090.lore: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.

5091.name: death_prophet_silence
5091.desc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
5091.lore: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.

5093.name: death_prophet_exorcism
5093.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.
5093.lore: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.

5094.name: sven_storm_bolt
5094.desc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
5094.lore: The Rogue Knight's iron gauntlet, taken from the school of his father, strikes his foes to their core.

5095.name: sven_great_cleave
5095.desc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
5095.lore: The Vigil Knights still seek to reclaim the stolen Outcast Blade from Sven, a weapon capable of cutting wide swaths through lesser warriors.

5096.name: sven_warcry
5096.desc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.
5096.lore: Calling a few lines from the Vigil Codex fortifies Sven's obedience to his rogue code. So poetic!

5097.name: sven_gods_strength
5097.desc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.
5097.lore: With the strength that shattered the Sacred Helm, the Rogue Knight stands unopposed in melee combat.

5098.name: storm_spirit_static_remnant
5098.desc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
5098.lore: Raijin Thunderkeg's duality allows him to admire himself in shocking fashion.

5099.name: storm_spirit_electric_vortex
5099.desc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
5099.lore: Raijin's thunderous, boisterous energy often draws others into an electrifying situation.

5100.name: storm_spirit_overload
5100.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

5101.name: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
5101.desc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool. Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.

5102.name: sandking_burrowstrike
5102.desc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
5102.lore: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.

5103.name: sandking_sand_storm
5103.desc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
5103.lore: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.

5105.name: sandking_epicenter
5105.desc: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
5105.lore: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.

5106.name: tiny_avalanche
5106.desc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
5106.lore: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

5107.name: tiny_toss
5107.desc: Grabs the nearest unit in a 300 radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
5107.lore: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.

5108.name: tiny_tree_grab
5108.desc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks. The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.

5109.name: tiny_grow
5109.desc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
5109.lore: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.

5110.name: zuus_arc_lightning
5110.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
5110.lore: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.

5111.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
5111.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.
5111.lore: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.

5112.name: zuus_static_field
5112.desc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
5112.lore: The air crackles with static when the Thundergod walks the world.

5113.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath
5113.desc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
5113.lore: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.

5114.name: slardar_sprint
5114.desc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has 100% slow resistance for the first 2.5s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
5114.lore: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.

5115.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
5115.desc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
5115.lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.

5116.name: slardar_bash
5116.desc: After 3 attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
5116.lore: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.

5117.name: slardar_amplify_damage
5117.desc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
5117.lore: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.

5118.name: tidehunter_gush
5118.desc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
5118.lore: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.

5119.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
5119.desc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5119.lore: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.

5120.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
5120.desc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.
5120.lore: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.

5121.name: tidehunter_ravage
5121.desc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
5121.lore: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.

5122.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
5122.desc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
5122.lore: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.

5123.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
5123.desc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives 20% extra bonus.
5123.lore: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.

5124.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
5124.desc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
5124.lore: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

5125.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
5125.desc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
5125.lore: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.

5126.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
5126.desc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
5126.lore: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.

5127.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
5127.desc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.
5127.lore: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.

5128.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura
5128.desc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
5128.lore: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylai's presence to allow spell usage in abundance.

5129.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
5129.desc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.
5129.lore: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.

5130.name: windrunner_shackleshot
5130.desc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it. If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.
5130.lore: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.

5131.name: windrunner_powershot
5131.desc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
5131.lore: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.

5132.name: windrunner_windrun
5132.desc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
5132.lore: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

5133.name: windrunner_focusfire
5133.desc: Windranger channels the wind to gain 0 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage. Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
5133.lore: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.

5134.name: lich_frost_nova
5134.desc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4 seconds. The primary target receives both base and area damage.
5134.lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

5136.name: lich_frost_shield
5136.desc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
5136.lore: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.

5137.name: lich_chain_frost
5137.desc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
5137.lore: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.

5138.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
5138.desc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
5138.lore: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.

5139.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
5139.desc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
5139.lore: Zharvakko's hocus pocus is not limited only to hexxing his opponents and is quite adept at curing ailments.

5140.name: witch_doctor_maledict
5140.desc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled units in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
5140.lore: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.

5141.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
5141.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.
5141.lore: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.

5142.name: riki_smoke_screen
5142.desc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
5142.lore: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.

5143.name: riki_blink_strike
5143.desc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
5143.lore: The Stealth Assassin's agile movement makes him impossible to escape.

5144.name: riki_backstab
5144.desc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

5145.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
5145.desc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
5145.lore: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.

5146.name: enigma_malefice
5146.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances. An instance strikes every 2 seconds.
5146.lore: Strange gravities pull at the core of those who would oppose you, holding them in place.

5147.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
5147.desc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
5147.lore: Enigma is capable of drawing aspects of himself from other dimensions - the result is a trio of dark eidolons that hunt the corporeal plane.

5148.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
5148.desc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
5148.lore: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.

5149.name: enigma_black_hole
5149.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units. Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
5149.lore: The ground trembles as Enigma channels his ultimate vortex of destruction, a singularity with the power to end worlds.

5150.name: tinker_laser
5150.desc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
5150.lore: Boush perfected this rock cutting laser in his subterranean laboratory, never considering its combat utility.

5152.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
5152.desc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
5152.lore: Even though the laboratory has since been sealed off, the ability to radio in robotic drones is still in working order.

5153.name: tinker_rearm
5153.desc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
5153.lore: A new battery here, another set of rockets there, Boush continually improves on existing technology.

5154.name: sniper_shrapnel
5154.desc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every 35 seconds.
5154.lore: Kardel's modular rifle also fires incendiary rounds, useful for assaulting entrenched locations.

5155.name: sniper_headshot
5155.desc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal 20 extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by -100%.
5155.lore: Taking potshots at steepstalkers in his childhood has been thoroughly refined into perfect leads on enemy combatants.

5156.name: sniper_take_aim
5156.desc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by 160.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by 65% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
5156.lore: Kardel always takes it upon himself to stay as far from harm as he can while still performing his role - taking perfect aim.

5157.name: sniper_assassinate
5157.desc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
5157.lore: In order to fulfill the prophecy and return to his home town, Kardel must make another shot as perfect as the one on the day of his ancient test.

5158.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
5158.desc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
5158.lore: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.

5159.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
5159.desc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
5159.lore: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.

5160.name: necrolyte_sadist
5160.desc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for 8 seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.

5161.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
5161.desc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
5161.lore: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.

5162.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
5162.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
5162.lore: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.

5163.name: warlock_shadow_word
5163.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
5163.lore: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.

5164.name: warlock_upheaval
5164.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
5164.lore: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.

5165.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
5165.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
5165.lore: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.

5168.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
5168.desc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path. Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
5168.lore: While learning to maneuver in nature alone, the Beastmaster also mastered the use of a pair of tomahawks, adept at cutting down trees as well as adversaries.

5171.name: beastmaster_boar_poison
5171.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

5172.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
5172.desc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
5172.lore: Beastmaster's ability to incite the innate strength of animals was seen in the mauling of the king of Slom.

5173.name: queenofpain_shadow_strike
5173.desc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds. An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
5173.lore: Akasha's envenomed dagger allows her to delight in the drawn out suffering of her victims.

5174.name: queenofpain_blink
5174.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
5174.lore: The Secret Queen lives up to her title, making her pain impossible to escape.

5175.name: queenofpain_scream_of_pain
5175.desc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

25% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
5175.lore: The sultry voice of Akasha beckons her opponents while stealing their souls.

5176.name: queenofpain_sonic_wave
5176.desc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
5176.lore: Her most exquisite of all of torments, Akasha's Sonic Wave puts her poor foes out of their misery.

5177.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
5177.desc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.
5177.lore: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.

5178.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
5178.desc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement. Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
5178.lore: A concoction of various stings, poisons, and toxins gathered from the jungles of Jidi Isle, victims surviving it are rare.

5179.name: venomancer_poison_sting
5179.desc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
5179.lore: The paralytic sting of the creature which caused his transformation now belongs to the Venomancer.

5180.name: venomancer_plague_ward
5180.desc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
5180.lore: A mixture of his old herbalist talents and newfound toxic mastery creates a living embodiment of plague.

5182.name: faceless_void_time_walk
5182.desc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds.
5182.lore: Darkterror tears a hole in time, passing through Claszureme, and appearing back in an instant.

5184.name: faceless_void_time_lock
5184.desc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
5184.lore: The strike of the Faceless Void lands with dimension shifting force.

5185.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
5185.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
5185.lore: When a rift opens to Claszureme, all poor souls caught within will likely never return.

5186.name: pugna_nether_blast
5186.desc: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area. Deals 65% damage to structures.
5186.lore: The Arts of Oblivion include a deafening blast of emerald flames from the Nether Reaches.

5187.name: pugna_decrepify
5187.desc: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
5187.lore: A now-mastered relic from his childhood, Pugna delights in banishing others into the Nether Realm, whether for good, evil, or simple enjoyment.

5188.name: pugna_nether_ward
5188.desc: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
5188.lore: While at the lamasery for the Arts of Oblivion, Pugna learned to dominate his classmates with a simple ward charged with Nether magic.

5189.name: pugna_life_drain
5189.desc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
5189.lore: Pugna has truly become more powerful than even the grandmaster of Oblivion.

5190.name: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
5190.desc: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65+30% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
5190.lore: The first skill learned by the Sisters of the Veil often signals an incoming hit.

5191.name: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike
5191.desc: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
5191.lore: Mortred's silken veil is the last thing her unfortunate target sees.

5192.name: phantom_assassin_blur
5192.desc: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
5192.lore: Meditation allows a Veiled Sister to carefully anticipate her opponents in combat.

5193.name: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace
5193.desc: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
5193.lore: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.

5194.name: templar_assassin_refraction
5194.desc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage. The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
5194.lore: Manipulating her psionic veil, Lanaya bends nature's law to her will.

5195.name: templar_assassin_meld
5195.desc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for 6 seconds. Bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
5195.lore: Lanaya is as elusive as her covenant with the Hidden Temple.

5196.name: templar_assassin_psi_blades
5196.desc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
5196.lore: Her blades pierce the skin as much as the mind, furthering her understanding of the mystery that is reality.

5197.name: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
5197.desc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of 20% in a 400 radius. Trap movement slow charges up to 50% after 3.5 seconds. Deals damage after 3.5s.
5197.lore: Calling upon the reach of the Hidden Temple, none escape the eye of the Templar.

5198.name: templar_assassin_trap
5198.desc:
Springs the trap nearest to Templar Assassin, slowing nearby enemies. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, springs the trap that is closest to the mouse cursor.

5199.name: templar_assassin_self_trap
5199.desc: Springs the trap, slowing nearby enemies.

5200.name: necronomicon_warrior_last_will
5200.desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

5202.name: necronomicon_warrior_mana_burn
5202.desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

5203.name: necronomicon_archer_mana_burn
5203.desc: Launches an arrow that burns away the targeted unit's mana, dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

5209.name: courier_shield
5209.desc: Summons a protective shield around the courier

5210.name: courier_burst
5210.desc: The courier gains a burst of speed for 6 seconds

attrib.header: MOVE PITS BONUS SPEED PER INTERRUPT:

5218.name: viper_poison_attack
5218.desc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.
5218.lore: The Netherdrake's inborn toxic breath quickly drains the vitality of its afflicted.

5219.name: viper_nethertoxin
5219.desc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
5219.lore: Poison from the Nether Reaches turns wounds into fatalities, and fatigue into death.

5220.name: viper_corrosive_skin
5220.desc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
5220.lore: It is not unusual for sword and shield alike to corrode in the very hands of those who attack the Netherdrake.

5221.name: viper_viper_strike
5221.desc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
5221.lore: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.

5222.name: luna_lucent_beam
5222.desc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
5222.lore: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.

5223.name: luna_moon_glaive
5223.desc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
5223.lore: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.

5224.name: luna_lunar_blessing
5224.desc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
5224.lore: The Goddess of the Moon smiles upon her kin.

5225.name: luna_eclipse
5225.desc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
5225.lore: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.

5226.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
5226.desc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
5226.lore: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.

5227.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
5227.desc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
5227.lore: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

5228.name: dragon_knight_dragon_blood
5228.desc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor. 

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.
5228.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

attrib.header: REGEN AND ARMOR MULTIPLIER DURING DRAGON FORM:

5229.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
5229.desc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
5229.lore: The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.

5233.name: dazzle_poison_touch
5233.desc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
5233.lore: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.

5234.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
5234.desc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
5234.lore: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.

5235.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
5235.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
5235.lore: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.

5237.name: rattletrap_battery_assault
5237.desc: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
5237.lore: Some of Rattletrap's contraptions don't quite work correctly, so detonating them proves useful as an offensive maneuver.

5238.name: rattletrap_power_cogs
5238.desc:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by 50% of the mana burned.

 Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to 1000 distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
5238.lore: One of Clockwerk's inventions of which he is most proud is the power cog - though it is sometimes despised by his allies.

5239.name: rattletrap_rocket_flare
5239.desc: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for 6 seconds.
5239.lore: What started as a festive display has become a useful scouting and bombardment tool.

5240.name: rattletrap_hookshot
5240.desc: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location. If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a 175 radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
5240.lore: A somewhat unwieldy device, the Hookshot sends the otherwise clunky Clockwerk armor flying through the air.

5241.name: leshrac_split_earth
5241.desc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
5241.lore: Twisting nature to his vile will, the shifting earth consumes those unlucky enough to cross Leshrac's path.

5242.name: leshrac_diabolic_edict
5242.desc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings. The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
5242.lore: Chronoptic energy bursts from one plane to the other, evaporating anything it touches.

5243.name: leshrac_lightning_storm
5243.desc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.
5243.lore: The Tormented Soul's mastery of the elements is evident in the massive storms that strike down armies before him.

5244.name: leshrac_pulse_nova
