5244.desc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.
5244.lore: If necessary, the Tormented Soul can manipulate space time itself, ravaging lesser beings.

5245.name: furion_sprout
5245.desc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.
5245.lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.

5246.name: furion_teleportation
5246.desc: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
5246.lore: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.

5247.name: furion_force_of_nature
5247.desc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
5247.lore: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.

5248.name: furion_wrath_of_nature
5248.desc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.
5248.lore: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.

5249.name: life_stealer_rage
5249.desc:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5249.lore: The madness and brutality of N'aix makes him a vicious and unrelenting foe in combat.

5250.name: life_stealer_feast
5250.desc: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
5250.lore: After escaping from his cell in Devarque, N'aix subsisted on flesh and bones of those unfortunate to cross his path.

5251.name: life_stealer_open_wounds
5251.desc: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
5251.lore: Fresh wounds and the scent of blood often draw out the scavengers to finish the job.

5252.name: life_stealer_infest
5252.desc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5252.lore: With this infestation, N'aix consumes the life blood of the host, restoring him back to full unholy power.

5253.name: life_stealer_consume
5253.desc: Lifestealer eats the host body from the inside out, exploding from within.

5255.name: dark_seer_vacuum
5255.desc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
5255.lore: Ish'Kafel modifies the center of gravity to a place of his choosing.

5256.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
5256.desc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
5256.lore: The Dark Seer slices holes into the 'Land Behind the Wall,' causing prismatic energy to seep forth.

5257.name: dark_seer_surge
5257.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
5257.lore: Ish'Kafel once used his speed of mind to navigate the maze between the walls.

5258.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
5258.desc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
5258.lore: The Dark Seer, while unable to return to his natural realm, can channel part of the prismatic wall with powerful strength of mind, sowing confusion amongst enemy ranks.

5259.name: clinkz_burning_barrage
5259.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
5259.lore: It's hard to say whether the blur around the Bone Fletcher is from his flaming heart or his speed with the quiver.

5260.name: clinkz_searing_arrows
5260.desc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.
5260.lore: Clinkz simply lights his arrows from his flaming essence for quite the destructive effect.

5261.name: clinkz_wind_walk
5261.desc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
5261.lore: With a burst of fire and puff of smoke, the Bone Fletcher was nowhere to be seen.

5262.name: clinkz_death_pact
5262.desc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
5262.lore: Sutherex' bond of life and death has become a part of Clinkz, and his old bones are refreshed with repetition of the pact on lesser beings.

5263.name: omniknight_purification
5263.desc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
5263.lore: Priests of the Omniscience are adept at removing impurities from fellow warriors.

5265.name: omniknight_degen_aura
5265.desc: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
5265.lore: The holy embodiment of Purist Thunderwrath is enough to weaken those of lesser faith.

5266.name: omniknight_guardian_angel
5266.desc: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
5266.lore: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.

5267.name: enchantress_untouchable
5267.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
5267.lore: After attacking Aiushtha, most opponents are overwhelmed with guilt having attacked such a natural beauty.

5268.name: enchantress_enchant
5268.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty. Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5268.lore: A true steward of the forest, Aiushtha befriends all within it - from lowly trolls to powerful centaurs.

5269.name: enchantress_natures_attendants
5269.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
5269.lore: Whimsical spirits of the woods possess a healing power that is quite subtle, but gains strength in numbers.

5270.name: enchantress_impetus
5270.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is. The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
5270.lore: While Aiushtha favors peaceful means, she is capable of a magical onslaught from a distance, her spears gaining energy from the natural life around her.

5272.name: huskar_burning_spear
5272.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
5272.lore: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.

5273.name: huskar_berserkers_blood
5273.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
5273.lore: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.

5274.name: huskar_life_break
5274.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed. While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5274.lore: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.

5275.name: night_stalker_void
5275.desc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
5275.lore: Balanar creates a vortex of infinite night, tearing opponents violently into the eternal darkness that once was.

attrib.header: DAMAGE PER SECOND WHEN NOT VISIBLE:

5276.name: night_stalker_crippling_fear
5276.desc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him. The effect lasts longer at night.
5276.lore: A vision of the twisted maw of Balanar etches itself into the minds of the poor souls unlucky enough to cross his path.

5277.name: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
5277.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
5277.lore: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.

5278.name: night_stalker_darkness
5278.desc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
5278.lore: It is a humbling sight to see when the mightiest of warriors become afraid of the dark.

5279.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
5279.desc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for 4 seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
5279.lore: Black Arachnia continues to raise her young, even amidst the field of combat.  The brood quickly learns how to support their mother.

5280.name: broodmother_spin_web
5280.desc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
5280.lore: Weaving a bed of silken fibers, Arachnia's web both protects her and her offspring, as well as giving advancing opponents a sense of foreboding.

5281.name: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
5281.desc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
5281.lore: Paralytic toxins come from Black Arachnia's fangs, causing a slow and painful death to those who intrude on her webs.

5282.name: broodmother_insatiable_hunger
5282.desc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
5282.lore: While most of her prey is wrapped in silken cocoons and saved for her young, the Broodmother herself has a taste for wandering heroes.

5283.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderite
5283.desc: Applies debuff on attack. If debuffed unit dies, a spiderling will spawn.

5286.name: bounty_hunter_jinada
5286.desc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
5286.lore: Gondar's vast experience ensures he never walks away from a transaction empty-handed.

5287.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
5287.desc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
5287.lore: The court jesters present during King Goff's assassination can recount no other image than a dancing shadow.

5288.name: bounty_hunter_track
5288.desc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
5288.lore: Using his elevated senses of sight and smell, Gondar's hits have quite a good chance of success.

5289.name: weaver_the_swarm
5289.desc: Weaver launches a swarm of 12 young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
5289.lore: Skitskurr opens a gap in the space time fabric, allowing young Weavers to slip through and aid him in combat.

5290.name: weaver_shukuchi
5290.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
5290.lore: As the Weavers worked in the fabric of creation, small wormholes allowed them to slip through time to better work their craft.

5291.name: weaver_geminate_attack
5291.desc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
5291.lore: Skitskurr's relationship with time is somewhat variable, causing his actions to be witnessed - and felt - more than once.

5292.name: weaver_time_lapse
5292.desc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5292.lore: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.

5293.name: kobold_taskmaster_speed_aura
5293.desc: The Kobold Foreman's cruel efficiency increases his movement speed and the movement speed of all nearby allies.

5294.name: centaur_khan_endurance_aura
5294.desc: The fearsome Hellbear attacks more quickly and bullies nearby allies into following suit.

5295.name: centaur_khan_war_stomp
5295.desc: The Centaur Conqueror's powerful hooves stomp the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemies. Heroes recover more quickly.

5296.name: gnoll_assassin_envenomed_weapon
5296.desc: The Vhoul Assassin has soaked his weapons in his own blend of painful predator venoms that causes his enemies' natural regeneration to work against themselves. Heroes recover from the poison more quickly.

5297.name: jakiro_dual_breath
5297.desc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
5297.lore: Pyrexae dragons have tremendously dangerous breath for each branch of the species; combining them is unimaginable.

5298.name: jakiro_ice_path
5298.desc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
5298.lore: Jakiro's cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.

5299.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
5299.desc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
5299.lore: The left maw of Jakiro opens, laying waste to any in its path.

5300.name: jakiro_macropyre
5300.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
5300.lore: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.

5301.name: ghost_frost_attack
5301.desc: The Ghost launches an eerie attack that chills her enemies to their bones.

5302.name: polar_furbolg_ursa_warrior_thunder_clap
5302.desc: The Hellbear Smasher claps his massive hands together, creating a deafening blast. The blast damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing.

5303.name: neutral_spell_immunity
5303.desc: This creature does not feel the effects of most magical spells.

5304.name: ogre_magi_frost_armor
5304.desc: The Ogre Frostmage summons an invisible layer of icy air that surrounds the target friendly unit, increasing its armor and temporarily slowing any enemies that dare attack it.

5305.name: dark_troll_warlord_ensnare
5305.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner tosses netting around an enemy's feet, briefly immobilizing the unit, though the unit can still attack and use abilities.

5306.name: dark_troll_warlord_raise_dead
5306.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner stirs the ground underfoot, raising the remains of trolls long dead, bringing to life three skeleton Warriors who will fight at his side.

5307.name: giant_wolf_critical_strike
5307.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious attacks occasionally tear a vital tendon, inflicting critical damage.

5308.name: alpha_wolf_critical_strike
5308.desc: The cruel Alpha Wolf attacks his enemy's unprotected vitals at every opportunity, inflicting critical damage.

5309.name: alpha_wolf_command_aura
5309.desc: The Alpha Wolf's ruthless attacks do extra damage. His commanding presence inspires nearby allies to attack ruthlessly as well.

5310.name: tornado_tempest
5310.desc: The Tornado's overpowering winds slow all nearby enemies, flinging debris at them and inflicting damage every second. Enemies closer to the center of the Tornado take more damage.

5312.name: enraged_wildkin_tornado
5312.desc: CHANNELED - The Wildwing calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a sentient Tornado that he can control. The Tornado slows nearby enemies and does damage. It is invulnerable and can move anywhere.

5313.name: enraged_wildkin_toughness_aura
5313.desc: The Wildwing Ripper's fury numbs it to attacks and inspires nearby allies to withstand more blows.

5314.name: satyr_trickster_purge
5314.desc:
The Satyr Banisher knows every trick in the book, allowing him to dispel debuffs from allies or buffs from enemies. His trickery also slows the enemy's movement.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

5315.name: satyr_soulstealer_mana_burn
5315.desc: The Satyr Mindstealer removes a fragment of his enemy's soul, burning away mana equal to 20 + 1x the target's intelligence, and dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

5316.name: satyr_hellcaller_shockwave
5316.desc: The Satyr Tormenter tears open an unstable rift to the underworld, creating a shockwave that travels in a line along the ground, dealing damage to enemies it hits.

5317.name: satyr_hellcaller_unholy_aura
5317.desc: The Satyr Tormenter's demonic communion allows him to emanate regenerative power, increasing the health regeneration of himself and all nearby allies.

5318.name: forest_troll_high_priest_heal
5318.desc: The Hill Troll Priest lays his holy blessing upon the target ally, replenishing some health.

5319.name: harpy_storm_chain_lightning
5319.desc: The Harpy Stormcrafter releases a high-voltage bolt of electricity at the target enemy, dealing damage. The bolt jumps to other nearby enemies, losing power with each jump.

5320.name: batrider_sticky_napalm
5320.desc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
5320.lore: It's not uncommon to hear the Rider cackle while he increases the flammability of his opponents.

5321.name: batrider_flamebreak
5321.desc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.
5321.lore: A molotov cocktail is the weapon of choice for Batrider.

5322.name: batrider_firefly
5322.desc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
5322.lore: When an enemy escapes into the Yama Raskav Jungle, most would cut through the brush to find the fugitive.  Batrider just chooses to destroy the jungle along with his foes.

5323.name: batrider_flaming_lasso
5323.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities. Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
5323.lore: Few dare to ask to ride on the bat, as Batrider gives them free of charge.

5324.name: black_dragon_splash_attack
5324.desc: The Black Dragon's explosive attacks are felt by all nearby enemies.

5328.name: chen_penitence
5328.desc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.
5328.lore: Although Chen's brand of animal enthrallment isn't quite strong enough to control the minds of enemy heroes, it still tests their resolve in combat.

5330.name: chen_holy_persuasion
5330.desc: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.
5330.lore: Although they may not be knights, Chen incorporates beasts into the Fold in the same way he himself was converted.

5331.name: chen_hand_of_god
5331.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 10 seconds afterwards.
5331.lore: Using the mental link with his thralls, Chen calls down restoration and well-being to those who share his fanaticism.

5332.name: big_thunder_lizard_slam
5332.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide slams his mammoth body against the ground. The shock damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing. Heroes regain their balance more quickly.

5333.name: big_thunder_lizard_frenzy
5333.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide works an ally into a frenzy, causing his ally to have increased attack speed.

5334.name: spectre_spectral_dagger
5334.desc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
5334.lore: Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.

5335.name: spectre_desolate
5335.desc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a 350 radius around them.
5335.lore: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.

5336.name: spectre_dispersion
5336.desc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
5336.lore: A daunting task lies before enemies of Mercurial - killing a shadow with blade and magic.

5337.name: spectre_haunt
5337.desc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
5337.lore: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.

5338.name: spectre_reality
5338.desc: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.
5338.lore: The scattered shadows unite into the one true Spectre.

5339.name: doom_bringer_devour
5339.desc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
5339.lore: Lucifer's appetite and greed are never sated.

5340.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
5340.desc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
5340.lore: The Fallen One spreads destruction in his wake, sparing none from the flame which sustains him.

5341.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
5341.desc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
5341.lore: Lucifer shares the fire branding bestowed upon him at the time of his exile.

5342.name: doom_bringer_doom
5342.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5342.lore: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.

5343.name: doom_bringer_empty1
5343.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

5344.name: doom_bringer_empty2
5344.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

5345.name: ancient_apparition_cold_feet
5345.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time. If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.
5345.lore: Kaldr's presence draws those around him into a frozen void, threatening to lock them in an icy prison for eternity.

5346.name: ancient_apparition_ice_vortex
5346.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
5346.lore: Frozen, caustic winds are at the whim of Kaldr, chilling the field of battle.

5347.name: ancient_apparition_chilling_touch
5347.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
5347.lore: The Ancient Apparition's eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.

5348.name: ancient_apparition_ice_blast
5348.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
5348.lore: Ice storms from ages past flow through Kaldr's frosty limbs, crashing into the world and turning its inhabitants into monuments to his eternal power.

5349.name: ancient_apparition_ice_blast_release
5349.desc: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

5350.name: backdoor_protection
5350.desc: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.

5351.name: backdoor_protection_in_base
5351.desc: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.

5352.name: beastmaster_greater_boar_poison
5352.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

5353.name: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
5353.desc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at 25% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after 1.5s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
5353.lore: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.

5355.name: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
5355.desc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
5355.lore: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.

attrib.header: CASCADING BASHES NETHER STRIKE ADDITIONAL COOLDOWN:

5356.name: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
5356.desc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
5356.lore: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.

5357.name: ursa_earthshock
5357.desc: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 4 seconds.
5357.lore: The very steps of a male ursine shake the ground as well as the resolve of opposing warriors.

5358.name: ursa_overpower
5358.desc: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
5358.lore: For a behemoth of his size, Ursa is deceptively nimble.

5359.name: ursa_fury_swipes
5359.desc: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage. If the same target is not attacked after 8 seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
5359.lore: In nature, the wounded rarely survive the attacks of hungry predators.

5360.name: ursa_enrage
5360.desc:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5360.lore: Ulfsaar succumbs to his ancient spirit, becoming the most ferocious creature on the battlefield.

5361.name: gyrocopter_rocket_barrage
5361.desc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts 3 seconds.
5361.lore: Aurel's new craft has an increased payload for rockets, enhancing their rapid-fire capabilities.

5362.name: gyrocopter_homing_missile
5362.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
5362.lore: The biggest missile Aurel could possibly attach to his craft, The Bomb has carefully calculated aerodynamics and explosives for maximum impact.

5363.name: gyrocopter_flak_cannon
5363.desc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.
5363.lore: This newly revamped Gyrocopter has attached enough armaments to assault in a 360 degree radius.

5364.name: gyrocopter_call_down
5364.desc: Call down 3 aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is 500 distance from the previous one.

5365.name: alchemist_acid_spray
5365.desc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
5365.lore: Using traditional Alchemy from the Darkbrew family, Razzil concocts an acid that dissolves even the toughest metals.

5366.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction
5366.desc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
5366.lore: A silver lining to the failure of turning a mountain into gold, this volatile solution has destructive potential.

5367.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction_throw
5367.desc: Throw it before it blows up!

5369.name: alchemist_chemical_rage
5369.desc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5369.lore: The brew Razzil gave to the Ogre during their prison bust has become a useful potion in the midst of combat.

5370.name: invoker_quas
5370.desc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.

5371.name: invoker_wex
5371.desc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.

5372.name: invoker_exort
5372.desc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.

5373.name: invoker_empty1
5373.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

5374.name: invoker_empty2
5374.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

5375.name: invoker_invoke
5375.desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

 Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
5375.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.

5376.name: invoker_cold_snap
5376.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.

5377.name: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
5377.desc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
5377.lore: Nortrom's lack of incantations is less of a problem for him than it is for his adversaries.

5378.name: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
5378.desc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
5378.lore: Although lacking in traditional incantations, Nortrom's pedigree of the Aeol Drias gives him uncanny wisdom, which he applies to physical combat.

5379.name: silencer_last_word
5379.desc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
5379.lore: Nortrom ensures that spells uttered by his opponents will be their last.

5380.name: silencer_global_silence
5380.desc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
5380.lore: With a shock to the ground, all magic and sound pauses, and Nortrom fulfills his prophecy.

5381.name: invoker_ghost_walk
5381.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.

5382.name: invoker_tornado
5382.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

5383.name: invoker_emp
5383.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.

5384.name: invoker_alacrity
5384.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

5385.name: invoker_chaos_meteor
5385.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.

5386.name: invoker_sun_strike
5386.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

attrib.header: CREATE FORGED SPIRIT ON HERO DAMAGE:

5387.name: invoker_forge_spirit
5387.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.

5388.name: forged_spirit_melting_strike
5388.desc: Melts away the armor of heroes hit by the spirit's attack. Each successive hit increases the amount of armor melted.

5389.name: invoker_ice_wall
5389.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

5390.name: invoker_deafening_blast
5390.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

5391.name: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
5391.desc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
5391.lore: Harbinger's outworldly knowledge allows it to tap into the ebb and flow of all spiritual energy, infusing it into his being.

5392.name: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
5392.desc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
5392.lore: Locked away in the pocket between this world and the Outworld, victims realize their infantile knowledge and mortality.

5394.name: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
5394.desc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your mana and the target's mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.
5394.lore: When an Outworld crystal ruptures, cataclysmic energies are released, and the reverberations of this power are felt interdimensionally.

5395.name: lycan_summon_wolves
5395.desc: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
5395.lore: The very enchantment that twisted his being also summons canine familiars.

5396.name: lycan_howl
5396.desc: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
5396.lore: Blood-curdling wolf cries signal to opponents that Banehallow is among them.

5397.name: lycan_feral_impulse
5397.desc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.
5397.lore: His animalistic symbiosis with canine kind gives Banehallow enhanced reflexes and hunting capabilities.

5398.name: lycan_shapeshift
5398.desc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed. Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
5398.lore: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his own savagery.

5399.name: lycan_summon_wolves_critical_strike
5399.desc: Gives 20% to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

5400.name: brewmaster_thunder_clap
5400.desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.
5400.lore: A slam of Mangix' mighty keg starts the festivities.

5402.name: brewmaster_drunken_brawler
5402.desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
5402.lore: When Mangix won his title as the Brewmaster of the Order of Oyo, he also claimed his place in the mastery of inebriation.

5403.name: brewmaster_primal_split
5403.desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn. Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
5403.lore: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.

5404.name: brewmaster_earth_hurl_boulder
5404.desc: Throws a boulder at a unit, doing damage and stunning it.

5405.name: brewmaster_earth_spell_immunity
5405.desc: Magic, status, and slow resistance increased.

5407.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
5407.desc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

5408.name: brewmaster_storm_dispel_magic
5408.desc:
Damages summoned units in an area and dispels most buffs or debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

5409.name: brewmaster_storm_cyclone
5409.desc: Encloses a unit in a tornado, removing it from the battlefield and deals 75 damage when after they land.

5410.name: brewmaster_storm_wind_walk
5410.desc: Provides temporary invisibility. Bonus movement speed and attack damage when invisible.

5414.name: lone_druid_savage_roar
5414.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.
5414.lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.

5415.name: lone_druid_true_form
5415.desc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
5415.lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.

5421.name: shadow_demon_disruption
5421.desc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration. Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
5421.lore: The pain of deception comes not while it happens, but when it is revealed.

5423.name: shadow_demon_shadow_poison
5423.desc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks cause 50 damage each. This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
5423.lore: The ever growing influence of the Shadow Demon can pollute the most valiant and pure of heroes.

5424.name: shadow_demon_shadow_poison_release
5424.desc: Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

5425.name: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
5425.desc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration. The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5425.lore: Once Shadow Demon no longer has any need for his collected cultist, he releases it from its subservience - and its life.

5426.name: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
5426.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
5426.lore: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.

5427.name: chaos_knight_reality_rift
5427.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.
5427.lore: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.

5428.name: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
5428.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
5428.lore: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

5429.name: chaos_knight_phantasm
5429.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5429.lore: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.

5430.name: meepo_earthbind
5430.desc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
5430.lore: Catching dinner in the Riftshadow Ruins can be quite the task.

5431.name: meepo_poof
5431.desc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
5431.lore: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind.  Or your other self.

5433.name: meepo_divided_we_stand
5433.desc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos. Damage, attack speed, health / mana regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

5434.name: treant_natures_guise
5434.desc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for 2.75 seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
5434.lore: The Protectors don't often come into vision; their natural state being nestled within their leafy brethren.

5435.name: treant_leech_seed
5435.desc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits 2 healing pulses to up to 5 nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
5435.lore: Rooftrellen nurtures the beings under his stewardship, sustained by the lifeforce of trespassers into his sacred ground.

5436.name: treant_living_armor
5436.desc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
5436.lore: The roots and tendrils of the Treant Protectors are far-reaching, stimulating the growth and rejuvenation of all of nature.

5437.name: treant_overgrowth
5437.desc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
5437.lore: Rooftrellen calls the ancestral spirit of nature, releasing its power through all of his kin.

5438.name: ogre_magi_fireblast
5438.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
5438.lore: The Ogre Magi is easily amused, entertained for hours by playing with fire.

5439.name: ogre_magi_ignite
5439.desc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.

5440.name: ogre_magi_bloodlust
5440.desc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
5440.lore: 'Running's not as fun as hitting... Not one bit fun.'

5441.name: ogre_magi_multicast
5441.desc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every 16 Strength adds 1%.
5441.lore: Despite being largely incapacitated by his IQ, the Ogre Magi's success in battle is attributed to pure skill.

5442.name: undying_decay
5442.desc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals 2x damage to creeps.
5442.lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.

5443.name: undying_soul_rip
5443.desc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
5443.lore: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.

5444.name: undying_tombstone
5444.desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point. Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them. Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
5444.lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.

5446.name: undying_tombstone_zombie_deathstrike
5446.desc: Slows enemy units on attack. If the attacked unit's health goes below the threshold, the zombie receives enhanced movement and attack speed.

5447.name: undying_flesh_golem
5447.desc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem. While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
5447.lore: The flesh of the recently dead add to the power of Dirge's plague.

5448.name: rubick_telekinesis
5448.desc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
5448.lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.

5449.name: rubick_telekinesis_land
5449.desc: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.

5450.name: rubick_fade_bolt
5450.desc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
5450.lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

5452.name: rubick_spell_steal
5452.desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
5452.lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.

5453.name: rubick_empty1
5453.desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

5454.name: rubick_empty2
5454.desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

5458.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
5458.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for x1.75 seconds. Provides vision of its target.
5458.lore: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.

5459.name: disruptor_glimpse
5459.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
5459.lore: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.

5460.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
5460.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
5460.lore: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.

5461.name: disruptor_static_storm
5461.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
5461.lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.

5462.name: nyx_assassin_impale
5462.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
5462.lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.

5464.name: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
5464.desc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
5464.lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.

5465.name: nyx_assassin_vendetta
5465.desc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has 75 additional attack range and a 70% faster attack animation for this attack.
5465.lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.

5466.name: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
5466.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
5466.lore: The 'who-casts-spell-first' argument between himself is solved simply by both casting at once.

5467.name: naga_siren_mirror_image
5467.desc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5467.lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.

5468.name: naga_siren_ensnare
5468.desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
5468.lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.

5469.name: naga_siren_rip_tide
5469.desc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for 4 seconds every 6 attacks.
5469.lore: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.

5470.name: naga_siren_song_of_the_siren
5470.desc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
5470.lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.

5471.name: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
5471.desc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled. Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path. The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
5471.lore: Ezalor's hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.

5473.name: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
5473.desc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.
5473.lore: In the same vein, Ezalor bestows his harmony among others.

5474.name: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
5474.desc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
5474.lore: In a flash of light, Ezalor reveals his true nature.

5475.name: keeper_of_the_light_recall
5475.desc:
After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location. If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

 If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead. 

 Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.

5476.name: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
5476.desc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.
5476.lore: The Primordial light turns the tides of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.

5478.name: naga_siren_song_of_the_siren_cancel
5478.desc: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

5480.name: visage_grave_chill
5480.desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
5480.lore: The warmth of the sun is never felt in the dark cold of the Narrow Maze.

5481.name: visage_soul_assumption
5481.desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
5481.lore: The collected souls of the dead reach out to bring another into their fold.

attrib.header: BONUS GOLD PER CHARGE PER KILL:

5482.name: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
5482.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
5482.lore: Visage's tough scales share equal properties of ghost and stone, making it nearly impervious to blade and magical assault.

5483.name: visage_summon_familiars
5483.desc:
Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage. Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing. While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health. Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.
5483.lore: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's Familiars stand watch over his domain.

5484.name: visage_summon_familiars_stone_form
5484.desc:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form. 

 Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

5485.name: wisp_tether
5485.desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
5485.lore: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.

5486.name: wisp_spirits
5486.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it. Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode. When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
5486.lore: Io twists the particles of the universe with its unimaginable capabilities.

5487.name: wisp_overcharge
5487.desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
5487.lore: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.

5488.name: wisp_relocate
5488.desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
5488.lore: Io is the embodiment of the mystery of the universe.

5489.name: wisp_tether_break
5489.desc: Break the link to the tethered unit.

5490.name: wisp_spirits_in
5490.desc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

5491.name: forest_troll_high_priest_mana_aura
5491.desc: Provides bonus mana regeneration to all nearby allies.

5492.name: courier_go_to_secretshop
5492.desc: Sends the courier to your team's secret shop

5493.name: wisp_spirits_out
5493.desc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

5494.name: slark_dark_pact
5494.desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself. Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5494.lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.

5495.name: slark_pounce
5495.desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
5495.lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.

5496.name: slark_essence_shift
5496.desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.
5496.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.

5497.name: slark_shadow_dance
5497.desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
5497.lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.

5504.name: medusa_split_shot
5504.desc: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
5504.lore: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.

5505.name: medusa_mystic_snake
5505.desc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
5505.lore: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.

5506.name: medusa_mana_shield
5506.desc: Creates a shield that absorbs 98% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb 60% less damage per point of mana.
5506.lore: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.

5507.name: medusa_stone_gaze
5507.desc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed. If 2 seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone. Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
5507.lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.

5508.name: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage
5508.desc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
5508.lore: Like his anger, Troll Warlord's supply of axes is infinite.

5509.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
5509.desc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over 950 range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
5509.lore: Only axes fueled by hate whirl with such a deadly spin.

5510.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
5510.desc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

5511.name: troll_warlord_fervor
5511.desc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed. If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
5511.lore: If at first you don't succeed, strike, strike again.

5512.name: troll_warlord_battle_trance
5512.desc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5512.lore: An adrenaline rush of pure hatred quickens your blades.

5514.name: centaur_hoof_stomp
5514.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.
5514.lore: When the mighty hoof of the Warrunner touches soil, the tremors are felt far and wide.

5515.name: centaur_double_edge
5515.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
5515.lore: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden's vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.

5516.name: centaur_return
5516.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
5516.lore: Bradwarden has no need to parry his opponent's attacks; his armor-like hide does it for him.

5517.name: centaur_stampede
5517.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
5517.lore: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.

5518.name: magnataur_shockwave
5518.desc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.
5518.lore: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.

5519.name: magnataur_empower
5519.desc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with 30% larger bonus.
5519.lore: With a deep bellow, Magnus displays his true power.

5520.name: magnataur_skewer
5520.desc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
5520.lore: Magnoceros horns are valuable in direct proportion to their danger to prospective merchants.

5521.name: magnataur_reverse_polarity
5521.lore: Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.

5524.name: shredder_whirling_death
5524.desc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
5524.lore: In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of his nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.

5525.name: shredder_timber_chain
5525.desc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it. Any enemy in the path takes damage.
5525.lore: You never know when you might need to escape from malevolent saplings.

5526.name: shredder_reactive_armor
5526.desc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as 4x the amount.
5526.lore: The saw-suit is equipped to react to the slightest touch with fortified defenses.

5527.name: shredder_chakram
5527.desc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted. While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.

5548.name: bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo
5548.desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5 seconds. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
5548.lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.

5549.name: bristleback_quill_spray
5549.desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.
5549.lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.

5550.name: bristleback_bristleback
5550.desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
5550.lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.

5551.name: bristleback_warpath
5551.desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
5551.lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.

5565.name: tusk_ice_shards
5565.desc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4 seconds.
5565.lore: In the frozen tundra near the Barrier, after the last sun of autumn has set, ice can form with alarming speed.

5566.name: tusk_snowball
5566.desc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a 325 radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
5566.lore: Tales are still told of the wild feat that ended the grand brawl at White Fields.

5568.name: tusk_walrus_punch
5568.desc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
5568.lore: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.

5581.name: skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt
5581.desc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
5581.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.

5582.name: skywrath_mage_concussive_shot
5582.desc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range. Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
5582.lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.

5583.name: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
5583.desc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
5583.lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.

5584.name: skywrath_mage_mystic_flare
5584.desc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2 seconds.
5584.lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.

5585.name: abaddon_death_coil
5585.desc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
5585.lore: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.

5586.name: abaddon_aphotic_shield
5586.desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5586.lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.

5587.name: abaddon_frostmourne
5587.desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.
5587.lore: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

5588.name: abaddon_borrowed_time
5588.desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5588.lore: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.

5589.name: elder_titan_echo_stomp
5589.desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations. The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
5589.lore: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.

5590.name: elder_titan_echo_stomp_spirit
5590.desc: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations. The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage. Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.
5590.lore: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.

5592.name: elder_titan_return_spirit
5592.desc: Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.

5593.name: elder_titan_natural_order
5593.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
5593.lore: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.

5594.name: elder_titan_earth_splitter
5594.desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
5594.lore: That which he created, the titan tears asunder.

5595.name: legion_commander_overwhelming_odds
5595.desc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a 100% impact slow for 0.3s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
5595.lore: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.

5596.name: legion_commander_press_the_attack
5596.desc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5596.lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.

5597.name: legion_commander_moment_of_courage
5597.desc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
5597.lore: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.

5598.name: legion_commander_duel
5598.desc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
5598.lore: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.

5599.name: techies_land_mines
5599.desc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active 500 AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for 1 seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within 150 radius and decreases up to 60% on the edge. Deals 30% damage to buildings.

5600.name: techies_stasis_trap
5600.desc: Plant an invisible trap that roots nearby enemy units instantly when triggered.

5601.name: techies_suicide
