5601.desc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

5602.name: techies_remote_mines
5602.desc: Plant an invisible explosive that will only detonate after a brief delay when triggered. Does not damage buildings.

5603.name: ember_spirit_searing_chains
5603.desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
5603.lore: Xin's harshest lessons often employed the use of red-hot chains.

5604.name: ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist
5604.desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location. Deals bonus damage to heroes.
5604.lore: The studied warrior must whip and weave through its enemies, burning each without pause.

5605.name: ember_spirit_flame_guard
5605.desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
5605.lore: An enemy should never be allowed to approach without difficulty.

5606.name: ember_spirit_fire_remnant
5606.desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant. Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
5606.lore: By the spirit's power are Xin's teachings spread anew.

5607.name: ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant
5607.desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
5607.lore: With blazing speed does a spirit fly!

5608.name: earth_spirit_boulder_smash
5608.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits. If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.
5608.lore: It is with the power of a mountain that Earth Spirit strikes his enemies.

5609.name: earth_spirit_rolling_boulder
5609.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
5609.lore: Calling upon his connection to the land, the Earth Spirit draws loose stone to him, which forms a protective ball that he can use to roll short distances.

5610.name: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
5610.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
5610.lore: Like calls to like. Even the minerals found in the blood and bones of living beings are not immune to the call of the Earth Spirit.

5612.name: earth_spirit_magnetize
5612.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
5612.lore: At the Earth Spirit's call, the minerals in the blood and bones of his enemies rebel against the bodies they find themselves in.

5613.name: abyssal_underlord_firestorm
5613.desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
5613.lore: The flames of conquest blaze forth from the darkest depths of the abyss.

5614.name: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice
5614.desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.
5614.lore: Twisting into the seams of reality itself, Vrogros' manifest hatred paralyzes those who defy his will.

5615.name: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
5615.desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
5615.lore: To merely stand in the presence of the Underlord is to feel the conviction of battle sapped from one's soul.

5619.name: terrorblade_reflection
5619.desc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
5619.lore: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.

5620.name: terrorblade_conjure_image
5620.desc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
5620.lore: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade.  Facing MORE Terrorblades!

5621.name: terrorblade_metamorphosis
5621.desc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within 1200 range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
5621.lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control.  Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.

5622.name: terrorblade_sunder
5622.desc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
5622.lore: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.

attrib.header: IGNORE MINIMUM PCT FOR ENEMIES TOOLTIP:

5623.name: phoenix_icarus_dive
5623.desc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
5623.lore: Though no stranger to travelling the cosmic void, soaring within an atmosphere offers unique pleasures.

5625.name: phoenix_fire_spirits
5625.desc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
5625.lore: The ever-collapsing core of Phoenix often emits short-lived bursts of conscious light.

5626.name: phoenix_sun_ray
5626.desc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
5626.lore: The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.

attrib.header: FOCAL POINT FULL LENGTH TOOLTIP ONLY:

5628.name: phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move
5628.desc: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.

5630.name: phoenix_supernova
5630.desc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After 6 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5630.lore: The solar crucible of a Supernova may be fatal, yet from its flames arise new beacons to wander infinity.

5631.name: phoenix_launch_fire_spirit
5631.desc: Each fire spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.

5632.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
5632.desc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
5632.lore: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

5635.name: techies_focused_detonate
5635.lore: Why light one fuse when you can light them all?

5637.name: oracle_fortunes_end
5637.desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
5637.lore: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.

5638.name: oracle_fates_edict
5638.desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them 100% magic damage resistance.
5638.lore: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics.  Other kinds of suffering however...

5639.name: oracle_purifying_flames
5639.desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
5639.lore: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.

5640.name: oracle_false_promise
5640.desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
5640.lore: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.

5641.name: tusk_launch_snowball
5641.desc: Launch the snowball toward the target.

5644.name: techies_minefield_sign
5644.desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

5648.name: earth_spirit_petrify
5648.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. 
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
5648.lore: Kaolin uses the elemental power of the Earth to temporarily petrify living beings, so that they might be conscripted into his stone funerary army.

5649.name: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
5649.desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
5649.lore: One can never be too certain who, or what, might need protecting.

5651.name: winter_wyvern_arctic_burn
5651.desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of 4% of their current health each second.
5651.lore: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.

5652.name: winter_wyvern_splinter_blast
5652.desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a 500 base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by 28%.
5652.lore: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.

5653.name: winter_wyvern_cold_embrace
5653.desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
5653.lore: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.

5654.name: winter_wyvern_winters_curse
5654.desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units.
5654.lore: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.

5656.name: granite_golem_hp_aura
5656.desc: Increases the health capacity of nearby units.

5666.name: nyx_assassin_burrow
5666.desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
5666.lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.

5667.name: mud_golem_rock_destroy
5667.desc: On death, Mud Golems shatter into several Shard Golems.

5670.name: mud_golem_hurl_boulder
5670.desc: Hurls a boulder at the target, damaging and stunning them.
5670.lore: \"Why do they hesitate? What are they afraid of throwing?\"

5672.name: tusk_walrus_kick
5672.desc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.

5673.name: nyx_assassin_unburrow
5673.lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.

5677.name: arc_warden_flux
5677.desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
5677.lore: An infinitesimal fraction of the power which imprisoned the Ancients.

5678.name: arc_warden_magnetic_field
5678.desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
5678.lore: Time and space are of little consequence to one as old as Zet.

attrib.header: RUNE PULL MAX SPEED AS MULTIPLIER OF PULL STRENGTH:

5679.name: arc_warden_spark_wraith
5679.desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
5679.lore: Lesser fragments of Zet's original self.

5681.name: black_dragon_dragonhide_aura
5681.desc: The Ancient Black Dragon's dreaded presence grants nearby allies additional armor. This bonus can stack with itself.

5682.name: big_thunder_lizard_wardrums_aura
5682.desc: The rhythm of the Thunderhide's heartbeat increases the attack speed and accuracy of nearby allies.

5683.name: arc_warden_tempest_double
5683.desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
5683.lore: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.

5684.name: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
5684.desc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.
5684.lore: The Outworld is awash in arcane energy, inclined to diffuse through any of Harbinger's rifts.

5685.name: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
5685.desc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.

5687.name: lone_druid_savage_roar_bear
5687.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.

5688.name: mudgolem_cloak_aura
5688.desc: This creature protects its allies with a Magic resistance aura. Creeps are better protected.

5689.name: black_dragon_fireball
5689.desc: Hurls a fire blast on the ground, igniting the area in a 300 radius for 8 seconds. Enemies caught in the fire will take 85 damage per second.

5690.name: invoker_attribute_bonus
5690.desc: Improves all attributes per point spent

5691.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
5691.desc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

5716.name: monkey_king_boundless_strike
5716.desc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
5716.lore: The legendary Jingu Bang grows to match its master's will, ensuring no enemy can escape the Monkey King's reach.

5719.name: monkey_king_mischief
5719.desc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.

5721.name: monkey_king_tree_dance
5721.desc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
5721.lore: Sun Wukong dances nimbly along the treetop canopy, always just out of arm's reach.

5722.name: monkey_king_untransform
5722.desc: Reverts Monkey King's shape to his original form.

5723.name: monkey_king_jingu_mastery
5723.desc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
5723.lore: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukong's combat fervor is on full display.

5724.name: monkey_king_primal_spring
5724.desc: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.
5724.lore: Leaping from the safety of cover into the midst of his enemies, Sun Wukong attacks without mercy.

5725.name: monkey_king_wukongs_command
5725.desc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of 1.1s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
5725.lore: Monkey King rips out a tuft of fur to blow at his enemies, charging each strand to transform into a copy of himself.

5750.name: elder_titan_natural_order_spirit
5750.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
5750.lore: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.

6270.desc: Stomps the ground, dealing damage to nearby units and reducing their base physical armor by 50%.

6278.name: spawnlord_master_freeze
6278.desc: Causes the next attack to petrify the enemy, rooting them and dealing 100 damage per second.

6325.name: zuus_cloud
6325.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

6339.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
6339.desc: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.
6339.lore: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in...

6340.name: dark_willow_bedlam
6340.desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies. Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
6340.lore: You'll have to excuse my friend Jex. He's really into murder.

6341.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
6341.desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.
6341.lore: What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.

6342.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown
6342.desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
6342.lore: Didn't anyone ever tell you? Never strike a deal with a fairy...

6343.name: pangolier_gyroshell
6343.desc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with 80% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
6343.lore: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...

6344.name: pangolier_swashbuckle
6344.desc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
6344.lore: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.

6408.name: special_bonus_unique_razor_2
6408.dname: -{s:bonus_strike_interval}s Eye of the Storm Strike Interval

6413.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_2
6413.dname: Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by {s:bonus_cooldown_reduction_per_kill}s

6461.name: pangolier_shield_crash
6461.desc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
6461.lore: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.

6470.name: void_spirit_dissimilate
6470.desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
6470.lore: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.

6480.name: snapfire_scatterblast
6480.desc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by 30% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
6480.lore: A favorite from her collection, Beadie crafted Ol' Rackatee as her first line of defense when she ventured into the Outlands.

6482.name: snapfire_mortimer_kisses
6482.desc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
6482.lore: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.

6483.name: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
6483.desc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
6483.lore: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.

6484.name: snapfire_gobble_up
6484.desc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to [object Object] seconds.

6486.name: snapfire_spit_creep
6486.desc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.

6488.name: snapfire_lil_shredder
6488.desc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
6488.lore: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.

6491.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
6491.desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
6491.lore: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...

6495.name: mars_gods_rebuke
6495.desc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
6495.lore: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.

6509.dname: 5% Fiery Soul Magic Resist Per Stack

6517.dname: +{s:bonus_boar_bonus_damage} Damage to Beastmaster and his summons

6526.dname: -{s:bonus_trigger_attacks} Moment of Courage Attacks To Trigger

6538.dname: +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% Liquid Frost and Fire Max Health Damage

6563.name: elder_titan_move_spirit
6563.desc: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

6582.name: mars_bulwark
6582.desc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

 Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
6582.lore: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.

6583.name: mars_spear
6583.desc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
6583.lore: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.

6937.lore: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

7116.name: visage_stone_form_self_cast
7116.desc:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.
7116.lore: There is no weapon or spell devised that can mar the wroughtstone servants of death.

7230.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
7230.desc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
7230.lore: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

7231.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
7231.desc: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
7231.lore: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

7300.name: huskar_inner_fire
7300.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
7300.lore: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.

7301.name: spirit_breaker_bulldoze
7301.desc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
7301.lore: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.

7306.name: chen_divine_favor
7306.desc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.
7306.lore: Chen's zeal is infectious, blessing his allies with vitality and compelling them to his side.

7307.name: pangolier_lucky_shot
7307.desc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
7307.lore: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.

7309.name: lone_druid_spirit_link
7309.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
7309.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

7310.name: brewmaster_cinder_brew
7310.desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.
7310.lore: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!

7314.name: antimage_counterspell
7314.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
7314.lore: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.

7316.name: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
7316.desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
7316.lore: Though he would not claim to 'know' them, Ezalor holds an uncanny influence over many powerful creatures always willing to come to his aid.

7318.name: meepo_ransack
7318.desc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
7318.lore: So you gonna need that, or...?

7319.name: clinkz_burning_army
7319.desc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.
7319.lore: Existing on the brink of life and death, Clinkz has learned to temporarily bridge the gap between the two.

7320.name: rubick_arcane_supremacy
7320.desc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
7320.lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...

7322.name: tusk_tag_team
7322.desc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.
7322.lore: Even far from Cobalt, Tusk carries the 'Barrier Chill' in his very bones.

7325.name: lich_sinister_gaze
7325.desc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

7701.name: void_spirit_aether_remnant
7701.desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
7701.lore: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.

7705.name: void_spirit_astral_step
7705.desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
7705.lore: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.

7710.name: void_spirit_resonant_pulse
7710.desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
7710.lore: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.

7739.name: primal_beast_rock_throw
7739.desc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

7804.name: seasonal_throw_snowball
7804.desc: Throw a snowball at an ally or enemy.
7804.lore: Hand crafted at the perfect temperature.

7806.name: seasonal_summon_snowman
7806.lore: He'll stay friends as long as he can.

7807.name: seasonal_decorate_tree
7807.desc: Give any tree a delightfully seasonal touch.
7807.lore: Festive trappings for even the bloodiest of battlefields.

7809.name: seasonal_festive_firework
7809.desc: Shoot a firework into the air.
7809.lore: There's nothing more festive than explosions!

7814.name: seasonal_summon_penguin
7814.desc: Summon a friendly penguin who slides around. Each time a hero bumps the penguin, it gains speed and lasts a bit longer.
7814.lore: Nothing gets age-old enemies to set aside their differences quite like a penguin to play with.

7828.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

7836.name: invoker_cold_snap_ad
7836.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.

7837.name: invoker_ghost_walk_ad
7837.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.

7838.name: invoker_tornado_ad
7838.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

7839.name: invoker_emp_ad
7839.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.

7840.name: invoker_alacrity_ad
7840.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed and their damage.

7841.name: invoker_sun_strike_ad
7841.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

7842.name: invoker_forge_spirit_ad
7842.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.

7843.name: invoker_chaos_meteor_ad
7843.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage and rolling further based on the level. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time.

7844.name: invoker_ice_wall_ad
7844.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.

7845.name: invoker_deafening_blast_ad
7845.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration then disarm their attacks for a duration.

7850.name: tiny_tree_channel
7850.desc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
7850.lore: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.

7852.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait
7852.lore: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.

7853.name: templar_assassin_trap_teleport
7853.desc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
7853.lore: In reward for her service, Lanaya has been granted access to secrets that unlock new techniques for her psionic gifts.

7888.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_7
7888.dname: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP

7902.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
7902.desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
7902.lore: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.

7903.name: dawnbreaker_converge
7903.desc: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.

7906.name: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
7906.desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for 6s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
7906.lore: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.

7914.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
7914.desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
7914.lore: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.

7979.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_8
7979.dname: 50% chance of Anchor Smash on attack

8000.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry
8000.desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
8000.lore: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.

8003.dname: +{s:bonus_AbilityCastRange}% Stroke of Fate Speed and Travel Range

8006.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
8006.desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
8006.lore: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.

8007.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk
8007.desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
8007.lore: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.

8026.name: special_bonus_unique_phantom_assassin_8
8026.dname: +{s:value} Range and Ground Target Stifling Dagger

8027.name: pangolier_rollup
8027.desc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
8027.lore: It requires deft tailwork and immense balance to defy momentum in the heart of battle.

8028.name: lich_ice_spire
8028.desc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
8028.lore: The waters within the Black Pool remain liquid far below the point of freezing and immediately crystallize when removed.

8030.name: faceless_void_time_walk_reverse
8030.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

8034.name: plus_high_five
8034.desc: Throw your hand (or handy appendage) in the air!

8035.name: plus_guild_banner
8035.desc: Plant your guild's banner to mark this battleground for you all!

8106.name: hoodwink_sharpshooter
8106.desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero. The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after x0.75 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after x0.75 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
8106.lore: While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.

attrib.header: QUICK DRAW TOOLTIP PCT COOLDOWN REDUCTION:

8107.name: hoodwink_decoy
8107.desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
8107.lore: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.

8158.name: hoodwink_bushwhack
8158.desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area. Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
8158.lore: Hoodwink favors Ironwood groves for ambushes, but the wary step carefully in all areas of the mistwoods.

8159.name: hoodwink_sharpshooter_release
8159.desc: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.

8192.name: marci_grapple
8192.desc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
8192.lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

8198.name: marci_unleash
8198.desc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for 2s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for 1.5s.

Marci gains 15% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
8198.lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.

8203.name: necronomicon_archer_purge
8203.desc:
Dispels positive buffs from enemies and slows their movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

8235.name: marci_companion_run
8235.desc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives 15% bonus movement speed for 4s.
8235.lore: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.

8340.name: dark_willow_terrorize
8340.desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
8340.lore: You think you know the first thing about fear? Jex'll show you what that word truly means...

8429.name: hoodwink_acorn_shot
8429.desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets. The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
8429.lore: Though she'll make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwink's stash.

9401.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_8
9401.dname: +{s:bonus_speed_bonus}% Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger

9418.name: special_bonus_unique_leshrac_7
9418.dname: Diabolic Edict Hits An Additional Target

9501.name: hoodwink_scurry
9501.desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.
9501.lore: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.
